clue.ro-haystack-description: Haystacks with a stick driven straight through them are common in rural areas.
clue.ro-dacia-car-description: Dacia is the dominant car brand in Romania with over a quarter of all vehicles.
clue.ro-elevation-map-description: Tallest mountains run through the centre and north; south and west are flat.
clue.ro-flat-agricultural-plain-descript: Flat agricultural land in south and west, with hills or mountains visible to the north or south respectively.
clue.ro-orange-tiled-roofs-western-half-: Villages with nearly all houses having orange tiled roofs are likely in the western half.
clue.ro-metal-fake-tile-roofs-eastern-ha: Villages dominated by metal or plastic fake-tiled roofs tend to be in the eastern half.
clue.ro-hungarian-style-village-descript: Near the Hungarian border, villages have long straight streets with evenly spaced single-storey houses and orange tiled roofs.
clue.ro-bilingual-hungarian-signs-descri: Common in central counties Covasna, Harghita, and Mureș, and near the Hungarian border.
clue.ro-decorated-wooden-gates-maramures: Elaborately carved wooden gates are characteristic of Maramureș in the north.
clue.ro-sunflower-field-description: Sunflower crops are primarily found in the far east and far west.
clue.ro-danube-delta-boat-trekker-descri: A trekker aboard a green boat navigates small overgrown canals in a flat landscape in the far east.
clue.ro-country-flag-description: The national flag of Romania is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.us-one-way-sign-description: US one-way signs are black rectangles with white arrows and 'ONE WAY' text.
clue.us-parking-sign-description: US parking signs are white metal with colored text specifying parking rules.
clue.us-green-highway-exit-sign-descript: Large green signs with white text mark exits and distances on US highways.
clue.us-blue-highway-service-sign-descri: Blue signs near exits list services like food, fuel, and lodging.
clue.us-rectangular-junction-sign-descri: Rectangular signs with arrows mark junctions in the US.
clue.us-fibre-optic-cable-marker-descrip: White-and-orange fibre optic cable markers are nearly exclusive to the US.
clue.us-orange-construction-barrel-descr: Orange plastic barrels with white stripes and black bases mark US construction zones.
clue.us-rumble-strip-description: Perpendicular pavement indentations, rumble strips, line edges and lane dividers on US highways.
clue.us-manufactured-trailer-home-descri: Small rectangular manufactured homes on blocks are common in rural America.
clue.us-baptist-church-description: Baptist churches are widespread across the US, especially in the Southern Plains and Southeast.
clue.us-us-only-gas-station-chain-descri: Fuel brands such as Exxon, Sunoco, Citgo, Speedway, Marathon, Phillips 66, 76, Conoco and Sinclair only operate in the US.
clue.us-overhead-traffic-light-bar-descr: Long metal arms with traffic lights, street signs, and highway signs extend over intersections throughout the US and Canada.
clue.us-thin-metal-sign-post-description: Thin metal sign posts, either perforated or U-shaped, are standard in North America.
clue.us-wooden-utility-pole-description: North America predominantly uses wooden utility poles.
clue.us-raised-insulator-pole-descriptio: Insulators raised slightly above the top of poles are characteristic of the US and Canada.
clue.us-long-nose-semi-truck-description: North American semi-trucks have a long nose with the engine ahead of the cab.
clue.us-water-tower-description: Tall water towers are common in US and Canadian towns, often displaying town or state names.
clue.us-missing-front-plate-description: About 22 states require only a rear plate; vehicles without front plates likely come from these states.
clue.us-alaska-licence-plate-description: Gold plate with dark blue characters and a yellow-gold background, easy to identify even blurred.
clue.us-alabama-licence-plate-descriptio: White plate with maroon-red characters and a large circular county emblem on the left side.
clue.us-arkansas-licence-plate-descripti: White plate with dark characters, red 'Arkansas' header, and a white diamond shape in the centre.
clue.us-arizona-licence-plate-descriptio: Plate shows a desert sunset gradient with blue, red, and white bands behind the characters.
clue.us-california-licence-plate-descrip: White plate with dark blue characters and a subtle red blob on top.
clue.us-colorado-licence-plate-descripti: White plate with green mountain scenery across the top and 'COLORADO' in green.
clue.us-connecticut-licence-plate-descri: Connecticut plates appear with a blue upper area and a pale lower area.
clue.us-district-columbia-licence-plate-: White plate with blue characters, red 'WASHINGTON DC' header, and a small red DC flag emblem.
clue.us-delaware-licence-plate-descripti: Dark blue plate with gold-yellow characters, distinctive even when blurred.
clue.us-florida-licence-plate-descriptio: White plate with green characters and two orange blobs from the orange graphic in the centre.
clue.us-georgia-licence-plate-descriptio: White plate with dark characters and a peach emblem in the centre.
clue.us-hawaii-licence-plate-description: White plate with dark characters and a rainbow arc across the upper portion.
clue.us-iowa-licence-plate-description: Blue-gradient plate with a county name across the top and dark characters on a lighter centre.
clue.us-idaho-licence-plate-description: White plate with a red 'IDAHO' header, dark characters, and a blue band along the bottom.
clue.us-illinois-licence-plate-descripti: White plate with dark blue characters on a reddish-maroon background with the Lincoln silhouette.
clue.us-indiana-licence-plate-descriptio: White plate with dark blue characters and a simple, clean design.
clue.us-kansas-licence-plate-description: Light blue plate with dark blue characters and 'KANSAS' header text.
clue.us-kentucky-licence-plate-descripti: White plate with blue characters, a dark blue band along the bottom, and 'KENTUCKY' in blue at top.
clue.us-louisiana-licence-plate-descript: White plate with dark characters and a red 'LOUISIANA' header, often with a fleur-de-lis or pelican emblem.
clue.us-massachusetts-licence-plate-desc: White plate with red characters and 'Massachusetts' in blue script at the top.
clue.us-maryland-licence-plate-descripti: White plate with dark characters and the Maryland flag pattern along the bottom edge.
clue.us-maine-licence-plate-description: White plate with dark blue characters and a green 'Maine' header with a chickadee emblem.
clue.us-michigan-licence-plate-descripti: White plate with dark blue characters and a blue 'MICHIGAN' header stripe across the top.
clue.us-minnesota-licence-plate-descript: White plate with dark characters and a broad teal-blue band across the top edge.
clue.us-missouri-licence-plate-descripti: Blue-tinted plate with white characters and a red emblem in the centre.
clue.us-mississippi-licence-plate-descri: White plate with muted blue-grey characters and a very plain design.
clue.us-montana-licence-plate-descriptio: Deep blue plate with white characters and a scenic background showing mountains and sky.
clue.us-north-carolina-licence-plate-des: White plate with blue characters, a red 'FIRST IN FLIGHT' header, and a small Wright Brothers airplane silhouette.
clue.us-north-dakota-licence-plate-descr: Light blue plate with dark characters and a brown-orange landscape band along the bottom.
clue.us-nebraska-licence-plate-descripti: White plate with blue characters and a simple, plain design.
clue.us-new-hampshire-licence-plate-desc: White plate with green characters and 'NEW HAMPSHIRE' in green.
clue.us-new-jersey-licence-plate-descrip: Pale yellow-cream plate with dark blue characters and a yellow gradient band across the top.
clue.us-new-mexico-licence-plate-descrip: Turquoise-teal plate with yellow characters and a red-orange Zia sun symbol in the centre.
clue.us-nevada-licence-plate-description: Light blue-grey plate with dark characters and a dark blue-silver mountain range at the top.
clue.us-new-york-licence-plate-descripti: Gold-yellow plate with dark blue characters and a bright yellow background.
clue.us-ohio-licence-plate-description: White plate with dark characters and a colourful scenic background including blue sky and green fields.
clue.us-oklahoma-licence-plate-descripti: Yellow-gold plate with dark characters and a dark scenic or emblem graphic.
clue.us-oregon-licence-plate-description: Blue plate with yellow characters and a tree or scenic graphic in the centre.
clue.us-pennsylvania-licence-plate-descr: Blue-and-white plate with a broad blue header band and a yellow footer.
clue.us-rhode-island-licence-plate-descr: White plate with dark blue characters and a small red anchor or sticker.
clue.us-south-carolina-licence-plate-des: White plate with dark blue characters, a blue header, and a dark palmetto tree emblem in the centre.
clue.us-south-dakota-licence-plate-descr: Blue plate with dark characters and a scenic Mt. Rushmore or landscape background.
clue.us-tennessee-licence-plate-descript: Dark blue-purple plate with lighter characters and a deep blue-violet background.
clue.us-texas-licence-plate-description: White plate with dark characters and 'TEXAS' in dark header text.
clue.us-utah-licence-plate-description: White plate with dark characters and a small American flag graphic on the left.
clue.us-virginia-licence-plate-descripti: White plate with dark blue characters and an orange county sticker in the upper-left corner.
clue.us-vermont-licence-plate-descriptio: Green plate with white characters and a solid green background.
clue.us-washington-licence-plate-descrip: White plate with dark characters, a red 'WASHINGTON' header band, and a dark blue flag emblem in the upper-right.
clue.us-wisconsin-licence-plate-descript: White plate with dark characters, a red 'WISCONSIN' header, and colourful small stickers at the top.
clue.us-west-virginia-licence-plate-desc: White plate with dark blue characters and a dark blue 'WEST VIRGINIA' header band.
clue.us-wyoming-licence-plate-descriptio: Yellow plate with dark characters and a bucking bronco silhouette on the left.
clue.us-interstate-us-highway-numbering-: Even-numbered Interstates and U.S. Highways generally run east–west, while odd-numbered routes run north–south. The two systems use opposite numbering directions geographically.
clue.us-three-digit-area-codes-descripti: US phone numbers begin with a three-digit area code mapping to specific regions.
clue.us-alabama-state-flag-description: A crimson St Andrew's cross (saltire) on a white field.
clue.us-alaska-state-flag-description: Eight gold stars forming the Big Dipper and Polaris on a dark blue field.
clue.us-arizona-state-flag-description: Alternating red and yellow rays radiating from a copper star on a blue lower half.
clue.us-arkansas-state-flag-description: A white diamond with a blue border and four blue stars on a red field.
clue.us-california-state-flag-descriptio: A grizzly bear walking on green grass above 'California Republic' on a white field with a red stripe.
clue.us-colorado-state-flag-description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white, and blue with a red 'C' encircling a gold disc.
clue.us-connecticut-state-flag-descripti: A blue field with the state coat of arms featuring three grapevines and a ribbon.
clue.us-delaware-state-flag-description: A colonial blue field with a buff diamond containing the state coat of arms and date 1787.
clue.us-florida-state-flag-description: A red saltire on a white field with the state seal in the centre.
clue.us-georgia-state-flag-description: Three red and white stripes with a blue canton containing 13 stars around the state coat of arms.
clue.us-hawaii-state-flag-description: Eight horizontal stripes of white, red, and blue with the Union Jack in the canton.
clue.us-idaho-state-flag-description: A blue field with the state seal and a red band reading 'State of Idaho'.
clue.us-illinois-state-flag-description: A white field with the state seal showing an eagle holding a shield with stars and stripes.
clue.us-indiana-state-flag-description: A blue field with a gold torch surrounded by 19 gold stars and the word 'Indiana'.
clue.us-iowa-state-flag-description: Three vertical stripes of blue, white, and red with an eagle carrying a blue streamer.
clue.us-kansas-state-flag-description: A dark blue field with the state seal above a sunflower and the word 'Kansas'.
clue.us-kentucky-state-flag-description: A navy blue field with the state seal showing two men embracing and the words 'Commonwealth of Kentucky'.
clue.us-louisiana-state-flag-description: A blue field with a pelican feeding her young above a ribbon reading 'Union, Justice, Confidence'.
clue.us-maine-state-flag-description: A blue field with the state coat of arms showing a moose, pine tree, and a farmer and sailor.
clue.us-maryland-state-flag-description: Quartered with the black and gold Calvert arms and the red and white Crossland arms.
clue.us-massachusetts-state-flag-descrip: A white field with the state coat of arms showing a Native American beneath a blue shield and gold star.
clue.us-michigan-state-flag-description: A dark blue field with the state coat of arms featuring an elk, moose, and an eagle above a shield.
clue.us-minnesota-state-flag-description: A dark blue field with the state seal featuring a farmer, a Native American riding into the sunset, and the motto.
clue.us-mississippi-state-flag-descripti: A magnolia blossom on a blue field with red and gold stripes, featuring the words 'In God We Trust'.
clue.us-missouri-state-flag-description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white, and blue with the state coat of arms in the centre surrounded by 24 stars.
clue.us-montana-state-flag-description: A blue field with the state seal showing mountains, Great Falls, and a plough and pick above a ribbon reading 'Oro y Plata'.
clue.us-nebraska-state-flag-description: A blue field with the state seal in gold and silver showing a steamboat, train, and a blacksmith.
clue.us-nevada-state-flag-description: A cobalt blue field with a silver star, sagebrush sprays, and a gold banner reading 'Battle Born'.
clue.us-new-hampshire-state-flag-descrip: A blue field with the state seal showing the frigate Raleigh surrounded by a laurel wreath.
clue.us-new-jersey-state-flag-descriptio: A buff field with the state coat of arms showing two goddesses flanking a blue shield.
clue.us-new-mexico-state-flag-descriptio: A red Zia sun symbol on a yellow field.
clue.us-new-york-state-flag-description: A dark blue field with the state coat of arms featuring Liberty and Justice flanking a shield with ships and a sun.
clue.us-north-carolina-state-flag-descri: A blue union with a white star, 'N' and 'C', and two dates, flanked by horizontal red and white stripes.
clue.us-north-dakota-state-flag-descript: A dark blue field with an eagle holding an olive branch and arrows, with a fan of stars above.
clue.us-ohio-state-flag-description: A unique burgee shape with red and white stripes, a blue triangle containing a white 'O' with a red centre.
clue.us-oklahoma-state-flag-description: A blue field with an Osage warrior's buffalo-hide shield decorated with eagle feathers and a calumet crossed with an olive branch.
clue.us-oregon-state-flag-description: A navy blue field with gold text 'State of Oregon' and the state seal on the front; a beaver on the reverse.
clue.us-pennsylvania-state-flag-descript: A blue field with the state coat of arms showing two horses flanking a shield with a ship, plough, and wheat sheaves.
clue.us-rhode-island-state-flag-descript: A white field with a gold anchor surrounded by 13 gold stars and a blue ribbon reading 'Hope'.
clue.us-south-carolina-state-flag-descri: A dark blue field with a white palmetto tree and crescent moon in the upper left.
clue.us-south-dakota-state-flag-descript: A sky blue field with the state seal surrounded by a gold sun and the text 'South Dakota. The Mount Rushmore State'.
clue.us-tennessee-state-flag-description: A red field with a blue circle containing three white stars, bordered by a white ring, and a blue bar at the fly edge.
clue.us-texas-state-flag-description: A vertical blue stripe with a white star, and two horizontal stripes of white and red.
clue.us-utah-state-flag-description: A dark blue field with the state seal showing a beehive, sego lilies, and an eagle above the date 1896.
clue.us-vermont-state-flag-description: A blue field with the state coat of arms featuring a pine tree, sheaves, and a deer head, with mountains in the background.
clue.us-virginia-state-flag-description: A blue field with the state seal showing Virtus standing over a defeated tyrant, with the motto 'Sic Semper Tyrannis'.
clue.us-washington-state-flag-descriptio: A dark green field with the state seal showing a portrait of George Washington.
clue.us-west-virginia-state-flag-descrip: A white field bordered in dark blue with the state coat of arms showing a farmer and miner flanking a rock with the date June 20, 1863.
clue.us-wisconsin-state-flag-description: A dark blue field with the state coat of arms featuring a sailor and yeoman flanking a shield, a badger, and the text 'Wisconsin' and '1848'.
clue.us-wyoming-state-flag-description: A blue field bordered in white and red, with a white bison silhouette bearing the state seal.
clue.us-topographic-overview-description: The western US has major mountain ranges and high plateaus; the east is lower with the Appalachians as the main highland.
clue.us-forest-density-map-description: Eastern and northern US regions have denser tree cover than western and southwestern areas.
clue.us-corn-field-description: Corn farming is concentrated in the Midwest and surrounding states.
clue.us-soybean-field-description: Short, dark green crops growing in long rows across the Great Plains, Midwest, and Lower Mississippi Valley.
clue.us-canola-field-canadian-border-des: Bright yellow canola flower fields appear in North Dakota and occasionally Montana near the Canadian border.
clue.us-cotton-field-description: Fluffy white cotton fields are found in the coastal Southeast, Lower Mississippi Valley, western Texas, and parts of California and Arizona.
clue.us-rice-production-area-description: US rice is grown in north-central California and the Lower Mississippi Valley. Fields resemble flat, low prairies.
clue.us-oil-pumpjack-description: Short industrial metal structures that pump crude oil, common in Texas, eastern New Mexico, and North Dakota.
clue.us-great-plains-description: A vast flat, largely treeless region from the Canadian border to central Texas with cropland and dry grassland.
clue.us-prairie-pothole-description: Low-lying wetlands with marshy grasses and shallow ponds from the Montana–Saskatchewan border to the western Great Lakes.
clue.us-appalachian-mountain-description: A low mountain range in the eastern US, covered in forest with beech and oak trees.
clue.us-southern-pine-description: Tall loblolly and longleaf pines with fluffy needle clusters abundant in the southeastern US.
clue.us-reddish-soil-deep-south-title: Reddish Soil in the Deep South
clue.us-reddish-soil-deep-south-descript: Soil ranging from yellow to deep red is common across the Deep South, from Oklahoma to South Carolina.
clue.us-dormant-southern-grass-descripti: Bermuda and St. Augustine grasses in the southern US turn beige or brown in winter.
clue.us-lower-mississippi-river-valley-d: An extremely flat, open landscape with red soil spanning Tennessee, Arkansas, Mississippi, and northeast Louisiana.
clue.us-rocky-mountain-description: Jagged, rocky formations from the Canadian border to northern New Mexico, often with pine forests and snow on high peaks.
clue.us-sagebrush-description: Great Basin sagebrush is a short, shrubby blue-green bush common in arid interior western US.
clue.us-saguaro-cactus-description: Tall tube-shaped cacti with upward-curving arms, found almost exclusively in southern Arizona.
clue.us-douglas-fir-cascadia-description: Extremely tall conifers with dark brown bark and dark green foliage, common in Washington and Oregon.
clue.us-pacific-temperate-rainforest-des: Coastal Washington, Oregon, and northern California have temperate rainforests with broadleaf trees, large conifers, and ferns.
clue.us-southwest-mesa-red-rock-descript: The Four Corners region features mesas, tablelands, and reddish rock formations with red soil.
clue.us-texas-hill-country-description: Dry, rocky hills west of Austin and San Antonio with yucca, prickly pear, and Texas Live Oak trees.
clue.us-rio-grande-valley-description: South Texas's Rio Grande Valley is flat with shrubby trees and agricultural fields bordering Mexico.
clue.us-spanish-moss-description: Greyish-white drapes of Spanish moss hanging from trees are a hallmark of the Deep South.
clue.us-golden-agricultural-field-easter: Expansive golden fields are common in eastern Washington.
clue.us-central-valley-california-descri: California's Central Valley has vineyards, olive trees, and rolling hills at the edges.
clue.us-nebraska-sandhill-description: A region of rolling, grass-covered hills in north-central Nebraska.
clue.us-appalachian-ridge-valley-descrip: Forest-covered ridges running southwest-to-northeast with flat valleys between, from southern New York to southern Virginia.
clue.us-ouachita-mountain-description: Steeper, more visible mountains from eastern Oklahoma into west-central Arkansas.
clue.us-alabama-highway-shield-descripti: Highway shields in Alabama are shaped like the state of Alabama in white with the route number in black.
clue.us-arkansas-highway-shield-descript: Arkansas shields are shaped like the outline of the state in white, with the route number in black.
clue.us-california-highway-shield-descri: White route number on a green spade-shaped shield.
clue.us-colorado-highway-shield-descript: Colorado shields are white rectangles featuring the state flag at the top.
clue.us-connecticut-highway-shield-descr: Connecticut shields are plain white squares with a black border, showing the route number in black.
clue.us-florida-highway-shield-descripti: Florida shields are simple white rectangles with the route number in black next to a black outline of the state.
clue.us-georgia-highway-shield-descripti: Georgia shields have a white silhouette of the state inside.
clue.us-idaho-highway-shield-description: Idaho shields have a white silhouette of the state inside, showing the state name in black to the right.
clue.us-illinois-highway-shield-descript: Illinois shields are showing 'ILLINOIS' in black at the top.
clue.us-indiana-highway-shield-descripti: Indiana shields are white squares with a black border, showing 'INDIANA' at the top.
clue.us-iowa-highway-shield-description: Iowa highway shields are black squares with the route number in black inside a white circle.
clue.us-louisiana-highway-shield-descrip: Louisiana highway shields are shaped like the outline of the state in green, with 'LA' at the top and the route number below in white.
clue.us-maine-highway-shield-description: Highway shields in Maine are plain white squares with the route number in black.
clue.us-nevada-highway-shield-descriptio: Some shields put the state name right on them, like Nevada's. A black square with a white banner inside showing the route number above 'NEVADA' in black.
clue.us-new-mexico-highway-shield-descri: New Mexico highway shields show the route number framed by a red ring with short red marks pointing out.
clue.us-north-dakota-highway-shield-desc: North Dakota highway shields are black squares featuring a white arrowhead silhouette with jagged edges, with the route number in black on the arrowhead and 'N' and 'D' in white at the top corners.
clue.us-oregon-highway-shield-descriptio: Black route number on a white shield with an oval shape.
clue.us-rhode-island-highway-shield-desc: Rhode Island shields are showing 'R.I.' at the top.
clue.us-south-carolina-highway-shield-de: South Carolina shields are white rectangles with a blue border, a blue banner at the top reading 'SOUTH CAROLINA' around a small white state outline, and the route number in blue below.
clue.us-tennessee-highway-shield-descrip: Tennessee shields are white with a black border and a curved bottom, showing the route number above 'Tennessee'.
clue.us-texas-highway-shield-description: Texas shields are white squares with a thick black border, showing the route number in black above 'TEXAS'.
clue.us-utah-highway-shield-description: Utah's shield is one of the most recognisable in the US: a white beehive on a black square with the route number in black inside the beehive.
clue.us-vermont-highway-shield-descripti: Vermont shields are white with a green border, showing 'VERMONT' in a green banner at the top and the route number in green below.
clue.us-virginia-highway-shield-descript: Highway shields in Virginia have a white shield in the middle containing the route number in black.
clue.us-adopt-highway-sign-description: Most states have unique Adopt-a-Highway sign designs found along roadsides.
clue.us-rectangular-raised-pavement-mark: Small rectangular raised markers embedded in the road surface appear in the southern and western US, plus Massachusetts.
clue.us-snowplowable-h-shaped-pavement-m: H-shaped pavement markers flush with the road surface are found only in a group of eastern states shown on the reference map.
clue.us-kentucky-rumble-strip-descriptio: Some Kentucky roads use uniquely shaped rumble strips, thin, elongated recessed lines on the outer road edges.
clue.us-brown-national-park-infrastructu: Guardrails, signs, and sign posts painted medium brown are characteristic of US national parks. Rock walls sometimes replace guardrails.
clue.us-wisconsin-missouri-lettered-coun: Wisconsin and Missouri Lettered County Highways
Wisconsin and Missouri use a letter system (A–ZZZ) for county highways. Wisconsin signs typically include 'County' above the letter; Missouri signs usually do not.
clue.us-concrete-paved-highway-iowa-desc: Concrete paving on main highways is far more common in Iowa than in other states.
clue.us-wide-gap-yellow-centre-line-desc: Double yellow centre lines with a noticeably wide gap between them are most common in Texas, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Oregon.
clue.us-thick-yellow-centre-line-wv-va-m: Thick Yellow Centre Lines, WV, VA, MD
Some roads in West Virginia, Virginia, and Maryland have centre yellow lines that are noticeably thicker than standard.
clue.us-oregon-speed-sign-speed-only-des: Oregon speed signs often display just the word 'Speed' rather than the standard 'Speed Limit'.
clue.us-california-black-stripe-centre-l: California Black Stripe Between Centre Lines
A black stripe can sometimes be seen between the two yellow centre lines on California roads.
clue.us-california-three-stripe-pole-mar: Utility poles in California typically have three yellow stripes painted near the base.
clue.us-california-road-without-centre-l: Some smaller California roads lack a yellow centre line entirely, featuring only solid white edge lines.
clue.us-nevada-bollard-description: Nevada uses bollards consisting of a thin stick topped with a vertical rectangular white reflector outlined in black.
clue.us-south-dakota-montana-bollard-des: A dark metal post with a white diamond reflector on each side at the top is the standard bollard in South Dakota and Montana.
clue.us-wyoming-bollard-description: Wyoming bollards are dark metal poles with a white circular reflector at the top. The top portion of the pole is sometimes painted white or grey.
clue.us-washington-state-bollard-descrip: Washington uses white or brown posts with a white rectangle on the front and two smaller white or silver squares on the back.
clue.us-utah-idaho-numbered-street-name-: Streets in Utah and Idaho often have a number and cardinal direction (e.g. '600 South').
clue.us-texas-road-surface-description: Texas roads often have a distinctive grainy, 'salt and pepper' pavement texture.
clue.us-upper-midwest-grainy-road-descri: Rural roads in the Upper Midwest, especially Illinois, use grainy pavement similar to Texas but in varying colours.
clue.us-texas-signpost-reflector-descrip: Yellow or red reflective bands are commonly wrapped around signposts in Texas.
clue.us-kansas-white-signpost-reflector-: White reflectors on signposts, especially on rural stop signs, are unique to Kansas.
clue.us-minnesota-bridge-warning-sign-de: Yellow signs with vertical black triangles appear before major bridge crossings and guardrail ends on large highways in Minnesota.
clue.us-minnesota-stop-sign-marker-descr: Most rural stop signs in Minnesota have a horizontal black-and-white marker attached to the post.
clue.us-wisconsin-atv-route-sign-descrip: Green 'ATV Route' signs are unique to Wisconsin.
clue.us-wisconsin-michigan-up-pole-plate: White rectangular metal plates with an orange rectangle and diamond are found on most utility poles in Wisconsin and Michigan's Upper Peninsula.
clue.us-wisconsin-white-bollard-descript: Simple white bollards with black reflectors are unique to Wisconsin.
clue.us-wisconsin-michigan-up-house-numb: Horizontal blue, red, or green signs at driveway ends show house numbers plus town or road names in Wisconsin and Michigan's Upper Peninsula.
clue.us-michigan-double-signpost-descrip: Signs mounted on two parallel posts are common in Michigan.
clue.us-michigan-wire-hung-traffic-sign-: Many Michigan intersections have stop lights and signs suspended from wires across the road, often in yellow boxes.
clue.us-ohio-michigan-indiana-property-m: Vertical blue or green metal signs with white house numbers, often attached to mailboxes, are common in rural Ohio, lower Michigan, and Indiana.
clue.us-west-virginia-fraction-circle-si: West Virginia street signs sometimes include a symbol resembling a fraction inside a circle.
clue.us-north-carolina-street-sign-numbe: North Carolina commonly uses street signs displaying block numbers and directional arrows alongside the street name.
clue.us-oklahoma-stop-sign-marker-descri: Green rectangular signs with three rows of numbers are commonly attached to the back of rural stop signs in Oklahoma.
clue.us-pennsylvania-intersection-route-: White rectangular signs showing converging state route numbers sometimes appear on signposts at Pennsylvania intersections.
clue.us-virginia-intersection-sign-descr: Rectangular white signs can sometimes be found at intersections in Virginia.
clue.us-north-carolina-white-signpost-si: White signs attached to signposts are common at intersections in North Carolina.
clue.us-south-carolina-black-street-sign: Black street signs with white text are common at intersections in South Carolina.
clue.us-square-guardrail-ny-wyoming-titl: Square Guardrails, New York and Wyoming
clue.us-square-guardrail-ny-wyoming-desc: Guardrails with a flat horizontal bar and square vertical supports dominate in New York and Wyoming.
clue.us-new-hampshire-e-2-bridge-sign-de: White metal signs marked 'E-2' are commonly placed at bridge ends in New Hampshire.
clue.us-vermont-stop-sign-number-plate-d: Small green signs with three rows of numbers appear on stop sign posts in Vermont.
clue.us-new-england-bridge-endpoint-mark: Small green and red rectangular signs mark ends of bridges and guardrails in Maine, New Hampshire, and Massachusetts.
clue.us-new-england-roadside-rock-wall-d: Short stone walls alongside rural roads are common in Connecticut, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and New Hampshire.
clue.us-appalachian-wooden-fence-descrip: Dark wooden fences with several horizontal rails are common on farmland from Pennsylvania to Georgia in the central and southern Appalachians.
clue.us-coastal-stilt-house-description: Houses elevated on tall stilts appear along the coast, especially in the South and on the Atlantic and Gulf coasts.
clue.us-short-stilt-gulf-coast-house-des: Houses raised 1–3 feet on short concrete or wood stilts are common along the western and central Gulf Coast near the coast and rivers.
clue.us-large-sloped-roof-building-descr: Buildings with oversized sloped roofs are most common in Oklahoma, Texas, and Louisiana, and occasionally in neighbouring states.
clue.us-new-england-shingle-walled-house: Coastal New England homes often have walls of overlapping wooden shingles.
clue.us-northeast-triple-decker-house-de: Older three-storey wooden 'stacked triplex' houses are common in urban New York, Connecticut, Rhode Island, and Massachusetts.
clue.us-brownstone-building-description: Row houses and government buildings made of brick and sandstone, common in dense urban Northeast US and Chicago.
clue.us-red-metal-rooftop-mid-south-sout: Red metal roofs are a common sight in the southeastern U.S.
clue.us-shotgun-house-description: Very narrow, one-storey wooden houses in a row, prevalent around New Orleans, Houston, Louisville, and Mississippi.
clue.us-pueblo-revival-house-new-mexico-: Sand-brown adobe or brick buildings with rounded edges and flat roofs, common in New Mexico.
clue.us-western-mountain-timber-building: Houses and commercial buildings built with dark wooden boards and timbers; metal roofs at higher elevations.
clue.us-shoprite-northeast-mid-atlantic-: ShopRite is a regional supermarket chain in Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, and Maryland.
clue.us-hy-vee-upper-midwest-description: Hy-Vee is a supermarket chain mainly in Iowa, Minnesota, Wisconsin, and Illinois.
clue.us-piggly-wiggly-southeast-wisconsi: Piggly Wiggly is a supermarket chain concentrated in the Southeast US and Wisconsin.
clue.us-publix-florida-deep-south-descri: Publix is a supermarket chain primarily in Florida and adjacent Deep South states.
clue.us-waffle-house-southern-southeast-: Waffle House restaurants are concentrated in the South and Southeast, especially Georgia.
clue.us-zaxbys-southeast-us-description: Zaxby's is a fast-food chicken chain most common in the Southeast, especially Georgia.
clue.us-whataburger-south-central-us-des: Whataburger is a hamburger chain across the South Central US, especially Texas.
clue.us-pizza-ranch-central-us-descripti: Pizza Ranch is a restaurant chain in the central US, concentrated in Iowa and Minnesota.
clue.us-tim-hortons-us-description: Tim Hortons has US locations mainly near Ontario and Quebec borders, plus scattered sites in Texas and Georgia.
clue.us-in-n-out-burger-southwest-us-des: In-N-Out Burger is a fast-food chain concentrated in the Southwest, especially California.
clue.us-wawa-mid-atlantic-florida-descri: Wawa is a gas station and convenience store chain in the Mid-Atlantic states and Florida.
clue.us-sheetz-eastern-us-description: Sheetz is a gas station and convenience store chain in the Eastern US, concentrated in the Mid-Atlantic and Central Appalachia.
clue.us-kwik-trip-upper-midwest-descript: Kwik Trip operates gas stations in Wisconsin and Minnesota; in Iowa it's called 'Kwik Star'.
clue.us-caseys-midwest-plains-descriptio: Casey's is a gas station and convenience store chain across the Midwest, Plains, and parts of the Mid-South.
clue.us-kum-go-iowa-based-chain-descript: Kum & Go is a gas station chain headquartered in Iowa, with clusters in the Ozarks, Colorado, Wyoming, and North Dakota.
clue.us-bucees-texas-description: Buc-ee's is a chain of oversized gas stations with many fuel pumps and large stores, found almost exclusively in Texas.
clue.us-alaska-description: The largest US state and the northernmost, westernmost, and easternmost state.
clue.us-hawaii-description: The youngest US state and the only one outside North America.
clue.us-puerto-rico-description: A Caribbean US territory with Commonwealth status.
clue.us-american-samoa-description: A South Pacific island group and unorganised US territory.
clue.us-guam-description: An unincorporated US territory and the largest island in Micronesia.
clue.us-northern-mariana-islands-descrip: A northwest Pacific island chain and Commonwealth US territory.
clue.us-us-virgin-islands-description: A Caribbean US territory and the only part of the US where traffic drives on the left.
clue.us-us-minor-outlying-islands-descri: A collective name for several small US island territories, including Midway Atoll.
clue.us-south-florida-everglades-region-: Dense, jungle-like forests with few inhabitants between Fort Myers and Miami. Roads are typically very straight and long.
clue.us-orlando-lakeland-hills-descripti: Low rolling hills with lakes and farmland between Orlando and Lakeland.
clue.us-wichita-mountains-southwest-okla: Rocky, shrubby peaks in southwest Oklahoma with some forested areas and pinkish-red rock.
clue.us-colorado-front-range-description: A north-south mountain ridge in central Colorado dividing the Rockies from the Great Plains.
clue.us-guadalupe-mountain-description: Tall, dry peaks along the New Mexico–Texas border with flat-topped foothills and shrubby vegetation.
clue.us-theodore-roosevelt-national-park: Sand-brown eroded formations with more trees on the rocks and autumn foliage.
clue.us-black-hill-western-south-dakota-: Moderately tall mountains with dense conifer forests and rocky outcroppings in western South Dakota and eastern Wyoming.
clue.us-country-flag-description: The national flag of the United States is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.at-licence-plate-description: Austrian licence plates are elongated and white, featuring the blue EU band on the left edge.
clue.at-chevron-description: Austrian curve signs have white arrows on red or red arrows on yellow boards.
clue.at-wooden-pole-description: The predominant utility pole across Austria is a rounded timber design.
clue.at-landscape-description: Most of Austria is forested mountain terrain, with eastern regions flattening into agricultural lowlands.
clue.at-alpine-architecture-description: Traditional Alpine homes have pale walls, wooden balconies, and wide overhanging dark timber roofs.
clue.at-german-language-description: Austria's official language is German, recognizable by characters Ä, Ö, Ü, and ß.
clue.at-direction-sign-description: Austrian directional signs have a white face framed by a blue border with a distinctive typeface.
clue.at-town-entrance-sign-description: Town name signs are white with a blue frame and the same characteristic font.
clue.at-green-facility-sign-description: Green directional signs point to nearby amenities and local facilities.
clue.at-pedestrian-sign-description: Austrian pedestrian crossing signs show two horizontal dashed lines instead of zebra stripes.
clue.at-four-metal-clip-mount-descriptio: Some road signs are attached to posts using four metal clips, unique in Central Europe.
clue.at-blue-road-marker-description: Austrian kilometre posts are blue with white numerals showing one decimal place separated by a comma.
clue.at-bus-stop-sign-description: Bus stops are marked with a circular sign combining yellow and green rings around the letter H.
clue.at-anfang-ende-sign-description: Parking restriction signs often include 'Anfang' (start) or 'Ende' (end) to mark zone boundaries.
clue.at-dead-end-sign-description: Dead-end streets are marked with an inverted white T sign.
clue.at-yellow-gas-pole-description: Bright yellow poles mark underground gas lines along Austrian roads.
clue.at-elevation-map-description: The centre and west are mountainous, while the east and north are flatter, with rolling hills.
clue.at-b-road-map-description: B-roads have white text on blue rectangles, with higher numbers in the west.
clue.at-burgenland-state-flag-descriptio: Horizontal stripes of red and gold (yellow).
clue.at-carinthia-state-flag-description: Horizontal stripes of yellow, red, and white.
clue.at-lower-austria-state-flag-descrip: Horizontal stripes of blue and yellow.
clue.at-salzburg-state-flag-description: Horizontal stripes of red and white.
clue.at-styria-state-flag-description: Horizontal stripes of white and green.
clue.at-tyrol-state-flag-description: Horizontal stripes of white and red.
clue.at-upper-austria-state-flag-descrip: Horizontal stripes of white and red (narrower than Tyrol's).
clue.at-vienna-state-flag-description: The Vienna coat of arms, featuring a white cross on a red shield, can be seen on flags and buildings throughout the city.
clue.at-vorarlberg-state-flag-descriptio: Horizontal red and white stripes with the state coat of arms.
clue.at-vorarlberg-neon-yellow-bus-stop-: Bus stops marked by neon-yellow poles.
clue.at-vorarlberg-pole-stripe-descripti: Poles wrapped with alternating yellow and white stripes.
clue.at-vorarlberg-white-km-marker-descr: White kilometre markers appear in Vorarlberg and western Salzburg.
clue.at-salzburg-road-square-description: Large white squares painted on the road near kilometre markers.
clue.at-burgenland-guterweg-sign-descrip: Rural roads signed with green 'Güterweg' plates.
clue.at-upper-austria-guterweg-sign-desc: 'Güterweg' signs are white with a black border.
clue.at-lower-austria-sign-border-descri: Signs sometimes have yellow and blue borders matching the state flag.
clue.at-eastern-vineyard-description: Wine-growing areas are in eastern Austria around Vienna and Lake Neusiedl.
clue.at-highest-alp-description: Austria's highest Alpine peaks cluster near the Italian border in the west.
clue.at-city-specific-street-sign-descri: Vienna shows district numbers; Salzburg, Klagenfurt, and St. Pölten have unique street sign styles.
clue.at-country-flag-description: The national flag of Austria is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.us-florida-county-shield-desc: Florida county roads have blue shields with yellow borders and large yellow numbers, often with the county name above.
clue.us-oregon-great-basin-desc: Gradual, rocky hills and plateaus with dry, shrubby vegetation, lacking tall peaks.
clue.us-oregon-county-shield-desc: Oregon county road shields feature a blue shield with a yellow border and large yellow numbers, sometimes with the county name in yellow.
clue.us-arizona-shield-desc: Arizona state route markers are a black silhouette of the state with 'ARIZONA' across the top and a large white route number in the centre.
clue.ro-vaslui-sign-desc: Blue signs with white border and text, sometimes featuring the city crest.
clue.ro-timisoara-sign-desc: Blue signs with thick white border and bold white lettering, often including the city coat of arms.
clue.us-idaho-great-basin-desc: Greener dry plains with patches of grass and shrubs, and occasional low mountain ranges.
clue.us-idaho-road-signs-desc: Idaho county road signs feature blue shields with yellow borders and large yellow numbers, sometimes with the county name.
clue.ro-galati-signs-desc: Blue signs with white border and text, sometimes featuring the city coat of arms.
clue.ro-timi-signs-desc: Blue signs with thick white border and bold white lettering, often including the city coat of arms.
clue.ro-vaslui-signs-desc: Blue signs with white border and text, sometimes featuring the city crest.
clue.utah-great-basin: Dry, open plains with scattered sagebrush and distant high mountain ranges in western and central Utah.
clue.us-utah-county-shield-signs-desc: Utah county road shields are blue with a yellow border and large yellow numbers, sometimes with the county name in yellow above the number.
clue.at-carinthia-bus-desc: Carinthian buses feature the 'kärnten bus' logo in blue and yellow with stylized text.
clue.us-michigan-county-shield-desc: Michigan county roads have blue shields with yellow borders and large yellow numbers, often with the county name or abbreviation.
clue.ro-bucharest-signs-desc: Green signs with white border and text, often featuring a colored band or city coat of arms.
clue.us-road-signs-02-yield-signs-descri: US yield signs are triangles with a red border and the word “YIELD” on a white background.
clue.xx-general-01-61-mailboxes-descript: Mailboxes with a small flag are a common sight in North America.
clue.us-49-nevada-description: Vast, arid plains with low shrubs and isolated mountain ranges, often snow-capped in winter and spring.
clue.us-49-utah-description: Dry, open plains with scattered sagebrush and distant high mountain ranges in western and central Utah.
clue.us-49-california-description: Dry, shrubby valleys and tall, often snow-capped mountain ranges in eastern California near the Sierra Nevada.
clue.us-49-oregon-description: Gradual, rocky hills and plateaus with dry, shrubby vegetation, lacking tall peaks.
clue.us-49-idaho-description: Greener dry plains with patches of grass and shrubs, and occasional low mountain ranges.
clue.us-palm-tree-description: Common along the Southeast coast, Gulf Coast, and Desert Southwest; Mexican Fan Palm prevalent in California.
clue.us-67-alabama-description: Alabama shields are black squares with a white silhouette of the state inside,
clue.us-67-alaska-description: Alaska shields are showing 'ALASKA' at the top, and a pattern of the Big Dipper at the bottom.
clue.us-67-arizona-description: Arizona shields are shaped like the outline of the state in white, with 'ARIZONA' in black at the top.
clue.us-67-arkansas-description: Arkansas shields are black squares with a white silhouette of the state inside, showing the route number in black.
clue.us-67-california-description: California shields are green and shaped like a miner's spade, with 'CALIFORNIA' arched in white near the top.
clue.us-67-colorado-description: Colorado shields are white squares with the state flag at the top.
clue.us-67-connecticut-description: Connecticut road shields are plain white with a black border and numbers.
clue.us-67-delaware-description: Delaware shields are black squares with a white circle inside.
clue.us-67-florida-description: Florida shields are white squares with a black border, showing the route number in black with a black outline of the state on the right side.
clue.us-67-georgia-description: Georgia shields are black squares with a white silhouette of the state inside.
clue.us-67-hawaii-description: Hawaii shields are black squares with a white rounded triangle.
clue.us-67-idaho-description: Idaho shields are black squares with a white silhouette of the state on the left and 'IDAHO' in white at the bottom.
clue.us-67-illinois-description: Illinois shields are white squares with a black border, showing 'ILLINOIS' at the top.
clue.us-67-indiana-description: Indiana shields are white squares with a black border, showing 'INDIANA' at the top.
clue.us-67-iowa-description: Iowa shields are simply black squares with a white circle inside.
clue.us-67-kansas-description: Kansas shields are black squares with a yellow sunflower shape inside.
clue.us-67-kentucky-description: Kentucky shields are black squares with a white circle inside, showing the route number in black.
clue.us-67-louisiana-description: Louisiana parish road signs use blue shields with yellow borders and large yellow numbers, sometimes with the parish name.
clue.us-67-maine-description: Maine shields are white squares with a black border.
clue.us-67-maryland-description: Maryland shields are white squares with a black border, showing 'MARYLAND' at the top.
clue.us-67-massachusetts-description: Massachusetts shields are plain white squares with rounded corners and a black border.
clue.us-67-michigan-description: Michigan shields are black squares with a white diamond inside, showing 'M' at the top.
clue.us-67-minnesota-description: Minnesota shields are yellow squares with a blue silhouette of the state at the top left, 'MINNESOTA' in blue to its right.
clue.us-67-mississippi-description: Mississippi shields are black squares with a white circle inside, showing the route number in black.
clue.us-67-missouri-description: Missouri shields are black squares with a white silhouette of the state inside, showing the route number in black.
clue.us-67-montana-description: Montana highway shields are white squares with a black border, showing 'MONTANA' at the top.
clue.us-67-nebraska-description: Nebraska shields are black squares with a white keystone shape inside, showing 'NEBRASKA' at the top and a black illustration of an ox-draw wagon at the bottom.
clue.us-67-nevada-description: Nevada shields are black squares with a white silhouette of the state inside, showing the route number in black above 'NEVADA' in black.
clue.us-67-new-hampshire-description: New Hampshire shields are white squares with rounded corners, showing a black profile of a man's face (the Old Man of the Mountain).
clue.us-67-new-jersey-description: New Jersey shields are black squares with a white circle inside, showing the route number in black.
clue.us-67-new-mexico-description: New Mexico shields are black squares with a white circle inside, framed by a red ring with groups of short red lines extending outward.
clue.us-67-new-york-description: In the state of New York, shields are black squares with a white shield shape inside.
clue.us-67-north-carolina-description: North Carolina shields are black squares with a white diamond inside.
clue.us-67-north-dakota-description: North Dakota shields are featuring a white silhouette of a Native American chief in profile with a feathered headdress and 'N' and 'D' in white at the top corners.
clue.us-67-ohio-description: Ohio shields are black squares with a white silhouette of the state inside.
clue.us-67-oklahoma-description: klahoma shields are white squares with a black outline of the state in the upper half.
clue.us-67-oregon-description: Oregon shields are black rectangles with a white rounded shape inside.
clue.us-67-pennsylvania-description: Pennsylvania shields are black squares with a white keystone shape inside.
clue.us-67-rhode-island-description: Rhode Island shields are white squares with a black border, showing 'R.I.'.
clue.us-67-south-carolina-description: South Carolina shields are reading 'SOUTH' and 'CAROLINA', with a small blue silhouette of the state in the middle containing a white palmetto tree and moon.
clue.us-67-south-dakota-description: South Dakota shields are green rectangles with a white silhouette of the state inside.
clue.us-67-tennessee-description: Tennessee shields are showing a small black outline of the state at the bottom containing 'Tennessee' in serif text.
clue.us-67-texas-description: Texas shields are white squares with a thick black border, showing the route number in black above 'TEXAS'.
clue.us-67-utah-description: Utah's shield is one of the most recognisable in the US: a white beehive on a black square with the route number in black inside the beehive."
clue.us-67-vermont-description: Vermont shields are green squares with a white box at the top showing 'VERMONT'.
clue.us-67-virginia-description: Virginia shields are black squares with a white classic shield shape inside.
clue.us-67-washington-description: Washington shields are black squares with a white silhouette of George Washington's head in profile.
clue.us-67-west-virginia-description: West Virginia shields are black squares with a white inner square with rounded corners.
clue.us-67-wisconsin-description: Wisconsin marks its state highways with a black and white sign with a triangular notch cut into the top edges and bottom.
clue.us-67-wyoming-description: Wyoming highway shields are yellow square signs with “WYOMING” at the top and a black silhouette of a cowboy on a bucking horse.
clue.xx-general-01-h-e-b-supermarket-cha: H-E-B is a supermarket chain that operates exclusively in Texas.
clue.us-128-california-usa-description: California fast food locations use the Carl's Jr. name and yellow smiling star logo.
clue.us-128-nevada-usa-description: Nevada features only Carl's Jr. branding with the yellow star mascot.
clue.us-128-arizona-usa-description: Arizona fast food outlets display only the Carl's Jr. name and yellow star logo.
clue.us-128-new-mexico-usa-description: New Mexico restaurants are branded as Carl's Jr. with the yellow star and red lettering.
clue.us-128-wyoming-usa-description: Wyoming has both Carl's Jr. and Hardee's locations, each with their own yellow star logos.
clue.us-128-oklahoma-usa-description: Oklahoma contains both Carl's Jr. and Hardee's restaurants with their respective yellow star logos.
clue.us-128-central-usa-description: Central US fast food locations are branded as Hardee's with a yellow star logo.
clue.us-128-eastern-usa-description: Eastern US uses Hardee's brand exclusively, identified by the yellow star logo.
clue.dk-licence-plate-description: Danish plates: standard white with blue EU band, yellow for commercial vehicles, and unique 'Parrot' variant with yellow left section.
clue.dk-square-block-edge-line-descripti: Danish road edges often marked by small white squares instead of dashes.
clue.dk-danish-language-description: Danish is a North Germanic language with letters Æ, Ø, and Å.
clue.dk-thatched-corrugated-roof-descrip: Thatched roofs are common in the countryside. Grey corrugated metal roofing also appears.
clue.dk-timber-framed-building-descripti: Half-timbered walls with exposed wooden frames are found on older and rural structures throughout Denmark.
clue.dk-bent-pipe-signpost-description: A signpost design where the tubular metal frame wraps tightly around the sign panel is unique to Denmark.
clue.dk-b-type-guardrail-description: Danish road barriers use guardrails with no reflectors.
clue.dk-five-stripe-pedestrian-sign-desc: The pedestrian crossing warning sign in Denmark shows five horizontal stripes, with the outermost stripes touching the edges of the triangular border.
clue.dk-town-entry-exit-sign-description: Settlements are announced by a distinctive rectangular sign displaying the town name. The exit version adds a diagonal red slash.
clue.dk-bus-stop-sign-description: Danish bus stops use a compact black-and-yellow sign mounted at the top of a pole, with the timetable below.
clue.dk-red-white-chevron-description: Curve warning boards in Denmark are red and white and tend to be positioned close to the ground.
clue.dk-rare-street-level-utility-pole-d: Conventional roadside utility poles are uncommon in Denmark. Most visible power infrastructure consists of tall high-voltage transmission towers.
clue.dk-roadside-bicycle-path-descriptio: Dedicated cycle lanes running alongside the carriageway are a frequent feature of Danish roads.
clue.dk-postnord-postal-box-description: PostNord operates distinctive postal collection boxes that are easily recognisable on the street.
clue.dk-gas-station-brand-description: Four fuel-station chains common in Denmark are Ingo, Ok, Uno-X, and Yx.
clue.dk-stone-bicycle-path-bollard-descr: Low stone bollards occasionally line bicycle paths, sometimes with a red-painted cap.
clue.dk-road-numbering-system-descriptio: Danish road numbers follow a clear east-to-west pattern with regional groupings. Starting with 200 and ending with 500.
clue.dk-ring-road-description: Major cities have numbered ring roads labelled O1 to O4, with higher numbers encircling further from the centre.
clue.dk-24-capital-region-of-description: Buses in the Capital Region are typically solid yellow or yellow with white and grey accents, featuring the Movia logo.
clue.dk-24-central-denmark-region-descri: Central Denmark Region buses are bright red with the white Midttrafik logo.
clue.dk-24-north-denmark-region-descript: Buses in North Denmark Region are bright blue, featuring the NT logo.
clue.dk-24-region-zealand-description: Region Zealand buses use Movia branding, usually yellow with white and grey details.
clue.dk-24-region-of-southern-descriptio: Southern Denmark buses are bright green (FynBus) or orange (Sydtrafik), each with their logos.
clue.dk-24-bornholm-description: Bornholm's buses have a distinctive blue and green two-tone scheme with the BAT logo.
clue.dk-25-capital-region-of-title: Capital Region Yellow Bus Stop Sign
clue.dk-25-capital-region-of-description: Bus stop signs have a bright yellow background with a black or dark gray band at the top, often showing the Movia logo.
clue.dk-25-central-denmark-region-descri: Central Denmark bus stop signs use yellow with a white or light gray section and the Midttrafik logo.
clue.dk-25-north-denmark-region-descript: North Denmark bus stop signs are yellow with a black or dark gray section and the NT logo.
clue.dk-25-region-zealand-description: Region Zealand bus stop signs have a yellow background with a white or light gray section and the Movia logo.
clue.dk-25-region-of-southern-descriptio: Southern Denmark bus stop signs are yellow with a gray or white section and the Sydtrafik logo.
clue.dk-25-bornholm-description: Bornholm bus stop signs are yellow with a black or dark section and the BAT logo.
clue.dk-country-flag-description: The national flag of Denmark is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.xx-general-01-57-argentina-chevrons: Argentina is the only South American country that has white chevrons with red arrows.
clue.au-bollards-01-description: Australian bollards are white with a vertical red stripe towards the top.
clue.au-road-01-driving-direction-descri: In Australia they drive on the left side of the road.
clue.au-road-signs-01-yellow-poles-descr: In the state of Western Australia you can find yellow sign posts.
clue.au-39-western-australia-description: Western Australia traffic light housings have a prominent white border framing the entire signal.
clue.au-39-queensland-description: Queensland's traffic lights have a bold white outline encasing the entire signal housing.
clue.au-39-new-south-wales-title: New South Wales White-Bordered Traffic Lights
clue.au-39-new-south-wales-description: New South Wales traffic light casings feature a thick white border around the housing.
clue.au-39-australian-capital-territory-: ACT traffic lights have white-bordered housings defining the signal edges.
clue.au-39-tasmania-description: Tasmania's traffic signals have a wide white outline framing the housing.
clue.au-39-victoria-description: Victoria traffic light housings lack any white border, appearing unframed.
clue.au-39-south-australia-description: South Australia traffic lights are installed without any white border.
clue.au-39-northern-territory-descriptio: Northern Territory traffic lights have housings with no white outline.
clue.at-24-burgenland-description: Buses display the 'Südburg' logo with bold red and white text and regional motifs.
clue.at-24-lower-austria-description: Buses show the 'NÖVOG' or 'VOR' logo, often in blue and yellow.
clue.at-24-salzburg-description: Buses display the 'Salzburg Verkehr' or 'Postbus' logo in red and white.
clue.at-24-styria-description: Styrian buses carry the 'Steiermark' or 'Verbund Linie' logo in green and white.
clue.at-24-tyrol-description: Tyrolean buses show the 'VVT' logo in red and white, often with the Tyrolean eagle.
clue.at-24-upper-austria-description: Buses display the 'OÖVV' logo, usually in red and white.
clue.at-24-vienna-description: Viennese buses feature the 'Wiener Linien' logo in red and white with stylized letters.
clue.at-24-vorarlberg-description: Vorarlberg buses show the 'Landbus' or 'VVV' logo in green and yellow.
clue.xx-general-01-29-vienna-street-sign: In Vienna, street signs appear as dark blue plaques, with the first number indicating the district.
clue.xx-general-01-30-red-and-white-tape: In Vienna and some smaller Austrian cities, signposts have red and white tape, resembling the Austrian flag.
clue.bd-licence-plate-description: Vehicles in Bangladesh have licence plates in white, black, or turquoise.
clue.bd-striped-signpost-description: Sign poles often have alternating black and white stripes.
clue.bd-white-painted-tree-trunk-descrip: Roads are often lined with trees whose lower trunks are painted white.
clue.bd-red-white-bollard-description: Concrete bollards alternate red and white and appear in cylindrical and square forms.
clue.bd-tin-roof-description: Corrugated metal roofing is widespread on residential buildings.
clue.bd-eastern-triangle-window-roof-des: Metal roofs in the east often have a small triangular opening below the ridge.
clue.bd-tiled-roof-khulna-border-descrip: Tile roofing appears near the Indian border within Khulna.
clue.bd-early-growth-rice-description: Short green rice shoots just above water appear in Khulna, Mymensingh, and south Dhaka.
clue.bd-mid-growth-rice-description: Medium-height green rice indicates mid-season growth in Rangpur, Barishal, and Chittagong.
clue.bd-fully-grown-rice-description: Mature rice is taller, yellow or orange, with fluffy tips signaling ripeness.
clue.bd-harvested-rice-description: Fields show short beige or brown stubble after harvesting.
clue.bd-off-season-field-description: Rice paddies lie empty and bare between planting cycles.
clue.bd-vast-empty-rice-field-descriptio: Expansive rice paddies stretch to the horizon with little else in sight.
clue.bd-eastern-chittagong-hill-descript: Forested hills break the flat terrain in eastern Chittagong.
clue.bd-sylhet-border-ridge-description: An east-west mountain ridge runs along the Indian border near Sylhet.
clue.bd-corn-field-description: Maize fields concentrate in western divisions like Rajshahi and Rangpur.
clue.bd-jute-crop-description: Tall green jute crops grow mainly in Rangpur; dried jute is seen nationwide.
clue.bd-canola-field-description: Short bright yellow canola blossoms grow north of the Padma River.
clue.bd-tea-plantation-description: Tea grows in elevated southern Sylhet and occasionally in Chittagong.
clue.bd-fruit-tree-orchard-description: Isolated fruit trees and orchards appear near the Indian border in Rajshahi and Rangpur.
clue.bd-barishal-sunflower-description: Sunflower fields appear in southern Barishal.
clue.bd-barishal-watermelon-description: Watermelon patches are found in southern Barishal.
clue.bd-northern-eucalyptus-description: Tall eucalyptus trees with pale trunks are common in northern divisions.
clue.bd-blossoming-tree-description: Flowering trees appear in Khulna, Mymensingh, and southern Dhaka during spring.
clue.bd-beach-sheoaks-description: Slender evergreen Beach Sheoak trees line the Teknaf Peninsula coast and Noakhali.
clue.bd-saint-martins-island-guard-trekk: On Saint Martin's Island, the trekker is accompanied by a security guard.
clue.bd-country-flag-description: The national flag of Bangladesh is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.by-language-description: Signage is in Belarusian or Russian, both using Cyrillic script.
clue.by-country-flag-description: The national flag of Belarus is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.be-concrete-pole-description: Utility poles are mostly square concrete with rows of small holes and often metal bands; some have oval perforations.
clue.be-direction-sign-description: Wayfinding signs in Belgium are typically blue or white. They are green on highways.
clue.be-blue-supplementary-sign-descript: Regulatory signs often have a small blue auxiliary plate beneath them.
clue.be-kilometre-marker-description: Distance posts are usually green and may have red numerals.
clue.be-chevron-description: Curve warning boards are white with a red arrow pointing toward the bend.
clue.be-concrete-slab-road-description: Many country roads are surfaced with precast concrete slabs.
clue.be-road-line-bike-lane-description: All road markings are white; dedicated cycle lanes often flank both sides of the carriageway.
clue.be-red-brick-architecture-descripti: Residential buildings made of distinctive red brick are widespread in northern and western Belgium.
clue.be-southern-stone-architecture-desc: Buildings in southern Belgium tend to be grey stone with French architectural style.
clue.xx-general-01-04-orange-signs-descr: In Belgium, you will often find orange signposts and sign backs.
clue.be-street-name-sign-description: Street name plaques are usually white or dark blue, squarish, and often include the municipality name.
clue.be-town-entry-sign-description: Settlements are marked by white rectangular signs with a black border and bold black municipality name.
clue.be-priority-sign-description: The orange diamond priority road sign is smaller than in neighboring countries.
clue.be-bus-stop-description: Bus stops have yellow signposts and often yellow-roofed shelters.
clue.be-traffic-light-pole-description: Traffic lights are mounted on poles painted with alternating black and yellow bands.
clue.be-hydrant-marker-description: Underground hydrants are marked by small red plates with the letter H.
clue.be-road-gutter-description: Kerbed gutters run along both edges of almost every road.
clue.be-bicycle-path-marking-description: Cycle paths are edged with short dashed lines on both sides.
clue.be-blurred-house-description: Belgium has one of the highest rates of building-level blurring in Europe.
clue.be-terrain-description: The northwest is flat, especially along the coast; terrain gets hillier toward the southeast.
clue.be-three-official-languages-descrip: Belgium has three languages: Dutch in Flanders, French in Wallonia, and German in Ostbelgien.
clue.be-bilingual-brussels-description: Brussels is officially bilingual with signage in French and Dutch.
clue.be-regional-bus-stop-difference-des: Bus stop signs in Flanders and Brussels have a white rectangle at the top; Walloon stops have yellow-topped signs.
clue.be-warning-sign-border-description: Flanders and Brussels warning signs have thick red borders without white rims.
clue.be-phone-area-code-description: Belgian landline numbers have one or two digits after the leading zero indicating the area.
clue.be-municipality-name-street-sign-de: Street signs often include the municipality name below the street name.
clue.be-ardennes-description: The Ardennes in southeastern Belgium feature rolling forested hills, deep valleys, and steep gradients.
clue.be-coastal-polder-description: Near the North Sea coast and western Dutch border, terrain has polders—fields at or below sea level with drainage channels and waterways.
clue.be-north-sea-coast-description: Belgian coastline features continuous rows of high-rise apartments and nearby dunes with low scrub, tall grasses, and sandy ground.
clue.be-country-flag-description: The national flag of Belgium is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.bm-general-landscape-description: Landscape has thick low greenery, small trees, dense bushes, and scattered detached houses.
clue.bm-licence-plate-description: Plates are elongated, entirely white, with black numbers centered.
clue.bm-road-marking-description: Most roads have a single solid yellow centreline and no edge markings.
clue.bm-zig-zag-line-description: White zig-zag road markings appear in some locations.
clue.bm-pastel-stone-house-description: Bermuda's signature architecture features stone homes painted in soft pastels with bright white stepped roofs.
clue.bm-palm-tree-description: Palm trees are abundant throughout the islands.
clue.bm-turquoise-water-description: The ocean around Bermuda has a strikingly pale turquoise colour.
clue.bm-country-flag-description: The national flag of Bermuda is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.bt-dzongkha-script-description: Bhutan's national language uses a distinctive Tibetan-derived script seen only in Bhutan on Street View.
clue.bt-mountainous-terrain-description: Bhutan is mostly rugged highland with steep mountain highways.
clue.bt-thin-metal-utility-pole-descript: Slender metal utility poles often have the lower section painted black.
clue.bt-kilometre-marker-description: Bhutanese road markers have a yellow upper half and white lower half with route numbers on national highways.
clue.bt-city-direction-sign-description: Urban areas have red or blue signboards usually showing the town name.
clue.bt-yellow-taxi-description: Bhutanese taxis have yellow roofs and yellow licence plates.
clue.bt-striped-signpost-description: Sign poles painted with alternating black-and-white bands are common.
clue.bt-double-white-edge-line-descripti: Roads with two solid white edge lines on each side appear around Thimphu in western Bhutan.
clue.bt-flat-southern-lowland-descriptio: Flat, open terrain occurs only in Bhutan's southern border zone.
clue.bt-country-flag-description: The national flag of Bhutan is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.bo-road-line-colour-description: Centre road markings vary between solid yellow, mixed yellow and white, or solid white; edge lines are always white.
clue.bo-concrete-slab-road-description: Many Bolivian roads are surfaced with precast concrete slabs besides asphalt.
clue.bo-cobblestone-road-description: Cobblestoned streets often have orderly stone strips separating less regular sections.
clue.bo-signpost-description: Road sign poles are thick, white, and square in cross-section.
clue.bo-guardrail-marking-description: Guardrail end-plates have yellow and black diagonal stripes, with yellow on the outer edge.
clue.bo-utility-pole-description: Main poles are cylindrical concrete with pinholes or timber, with varied crossarm designs.
clue.bo-kilometre-marker-description: Distance posts have a black 'Km' upper section and white lower section with the distance figure.
clue.bo-mas-political-graffiti-descripti: Graffiti reading 'MAS' or 'Evo' and objects painted black, white, and blue mark the ruling party.
clue.bo-wiphala-flag-description: The Wiphala is a square flag with seven colours in diagonal stripes, seen on public buildings and signage.
clue.bo-tigo-telecom-branding-descriptio: Tigo's blue logo appears frequently in Bolivian urban areas.
clue.bo-reddish-soil-description: Exposed rock and earth often have a pronounced red-orange hue.
clue.bo-altiplano-description: A highland plateau with grasslands ranging from green to brown, often with clumpy tufted grass.
clue.bo-northern-altiplano-greener-descr: The plateau near La Paz and El Alto appears greener and more vegetated.
clue.bo-southern-altiplano-drier-descrip: Around Oruro and southwest roads, the plateau is more barren and dry.
clue.bo-andean-mountain-description: Towering peaks run northwest to southeast between the Altiplano and tropical lowlands.
clue.bo-tropical-eastern-lowland-descrip: East of the Andes, terrain flattens into lush tropical farmland with distinctive pinkish soil.
clue.bo-santa-cruz-unpaved-road-descript: Dirt roads near Santa Cruz have characteristic pink soil.
clue.bo-santa-cruz-tropical-setting-desc: Santa Cruz is Bolivia's only major city in a flat, tropical environment.
clue.bo-morochata-peru-look-alike-descri: A coverage pocket on Ruta 25 northwest of Cochabamba with green mountain slopes and drier terrain.
clue.bo-ruta-5-sunset-coverage-descripti: Ruta 5 near Chaco was captured at sunset, showing a warm golden tint on mostly concrete roads.
clue.bo-ruta-6-white-concrete-descriptio: Between Tarabuco and Zudáñez, the road is paved with almost white concrete.
clue.bo-country-flag-description: The national flag of Bolivia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.ba-bollard-variant-1-title: White Bollard with Angled Top (No Black Cap or Band)
clue.ba-bollard-variant-1-description: Slim white rectangular bollard with the top corner cut off at a diagonal angle. There is NO black cap at the top and NO black band around the shaft. A small rectangular reflector sits on a small dark patch just below the angled top.
clue.ba-bollard-variant-2-title: White Bollard with Solid Black Block on Top
clue.ba-bollard-variant-2-description: Slim white rectangular bollard with a thick solid black block sitting flat on top, like a hat. The rectangular reflector is on the white shaft, BELOW the black cap.
clue.ba-bollard-variant-3-title: White Bollard with Wide Black Band (White Tip Above)
clue.ba-country-flag-description: The national flag of Bosnia and Herzegovina is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.bw-language-description: Road signage is in English; place names derive from Tswana and local languages.
clue.bw-road-line-colour-description: Edge lines in Botswana are yellow and centre lines are white.
clue.b-general-01-black-and-yellow-signp: If you're in southern Africa and come across this, you know you're in Botswana.
clue.bw-striped-curb-guardrail-descripti: Kerbs and guardrails are painted in black-and-yellow, red-and-white, or black-and-white stripes.
clue.bw-legacy-blue-sign-description: Older road signs have blue backgrounds but are being replaced by white-background signs.
clue.bw-architecture-description: Housing in Botswana ranges from tin-roof shacks to single-storey bungalows and occasional traditional circular huts.
clue.bw-random-small-blur-description: Google's blurring algorithm places small random patches of blur, mostly in towns.
clue.bw-region-map-description: Botswana has distinct landscape zones marked by soil colour and vegetation.
clue.bw-paved-vs-unpaved-road-descriptio: Map shows which routes are surfaced and which are dirt or gravel.
clue.bw-elevation-description: Most of Botswana is flat; hills appear mainly in two areas with some isolated outcrops.
clue.bw-southeast-scrub-hill-description: Between Gaborone and Lobatse are low, scrubby hills in a semi-arid setting.
clue.bw-eastern-red-soil-pocket-descript: North of Francistown, soil is firm, rocky red with yellowed or leafless trees.
clue.bw-white-sand-region-description: Mid-western interior has bright white sandy soil and parched vegetation.
clue.bw-gaborone-description: The capital is more developed and affluent, mostly flat with some southern hills.
clue.bw-chobe-flood-plain-description: Northern area near Chobe River has dirt tracks, dense green bush, and visible wildlife.
clue.bw-salt-pan-description: Central-east has vast salt flats around Nwetwe pan, accessed by dirt roads.
clue.bw-country-flag-description: The national flag of Botswana is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.br-licence-plate-description: Pre-2018 plates were plain white; current plates have a blue strip on top; commercial plates are red.
clue.br-language-01-portuguese-descripti: Brazil is the only South American country that uses the Portuguese language. It has the letter “Ç”, something Spanish does not.
clue.br-nature-01-red-soil-description: This iron rich, red soil is primarily found in Brazil.
clue.xx-pole-01-ladder-poles-description: The poles you often see in Brazil have a ladder-like design at the base. They have horizontal sections near the bottom.
clue.br-blue-kilometre-marker-descriptio: Small blue roadside posts show the route number and current kilometre.
clue.br-chevron-description: Brazilian curve signs use yellow arrows on black boards.
clue.br-road-marking-description: Centre lines are typically double solid yellow; edge lines are white.
clue.br-white-painted-kerb-description: Kerbstones along Brazilian roads are frequently painted white.
clue.br-orange-roof-tile-description: Terracotta-orange clay tiles are standard roofing material nationwide.
clue.br-transparent-satellite-dish-descr: Clear or translucent satellite dishes on rooftops are common and unique in Latin America.
clue.br-fortlev-water-tank-description: Blue Fortlev-branded rooftop water tanks are common on Brazilian homes.
clue.br-misc-01-phone-numbers-descriptio: Phone numbers in Brazil often include an area code as a separate two-digit prefix.
clue.br-general-01-states-description: Finding state abbreviations is common in Brazil. The abbreviations can be seen on the map on certain zoom levels.
clue.br-postcode-cep-description: Postal codes on street signs start with two digits indicating region or state.
clue.br-elevation-map-description: Brazil's tallest peaks cluster near the southeast coast; interior states are flatter.
clue.br-caatinga-northeast-description: Northeast interior features dry soil, thorny scrub, and succulents of the Caatinga biome.
clue.br-amazon-rainforest-description: Amazon covers 40% of Brazil with few roads through dense forest or grassy hills.
clue.br-acre-landscape-description: Acre has low grassy mounds with thinly spaced trees and roads cresting hills.
clue.br-roraima-plain-description: Roraima features expansive grasslands with wispy grass in discrete clumps and distant mountains.
clue.br-rio-grande-do-sul-description: Landscape alternates between rolling hills and flat green pastures.
clue.br-southeastern-rolling-hill-descri: Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, and Espírito Santo have gentle grass-covered rolling hills.
clue.br-exposed-rock-mountain-descriptio: Tall mountains with bare rock faces are common in Espírito Santo and nearby regions.
clue.br-parana-pine-description: Araucaria trees have long horizontal branches with foliage clustered at tips, found in Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul.
clue.br-coconut-palm-description: Tall slender palms with long fronds grow along the northeastern coast.
clue.br-carnauba-palm-description: Palms with compact fan-shaped leaves and spiky lower trunks, concentrated in Ceará.
clue.br-babassu-palm-description: Large palms with heavy leaflet fronds found throughout the Amazon and eastern seaboard.
clue.br-acai-palm-description: Thin-trunked palms with downward-hanging leaflets, abundant around Belém and the Amazon basin.
clue.br-moriche-palm-description: Palms with broad, rounded fan-shaped leaves, concentrated in Amazonas, Acre, and Roraima.
clue.br-macaw-palm-description: Narrow-leaved palms with pointed spear-shaped crowns, common around Mato Grosso do Sul.
clue.br-long-stemmed-plant-description: Tall, erect stems topped by upward-growing leaf clusters, characteristic of Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, and Paraíba.
clue.br-tall-roadside-grass-description: Exceptionally tall grass flanking roads in Tocantins, Goiás, Bahia, and Minas Gerais.
clue.br-eucalyptus-plantation-descriptio: Rows of extremely tall, straight Eucalyptus Grandis trees across southern Brazil and some in Amapá.
clue.br-sugarcane-description: Sugarcane fields concentrated in São Paulo and the northeastern coast, especially Alagoas and Pernambuco.
clue.br-soybean-field-description: Low, bushy soybean crops in Mato Grosso, Paraná, and Goiás.
clue.br-coffee-plantation-description: Coffee cultivation dominated by Minas Gerais, with areas in Espírito Santo and northeastern São Paulo.
clue.br-round-concrete-pole-description: Cylindrical concrete poles common in southern states and São Paulo; large cities use round poles.
clue.br-wooden-pole-description: Timber utility poles prevalent in Rio Grande do Sul, Roraima, Amazonas, and Rio de Janeiro.
clue.br-bahia-pernambuco-pole-id-descrip: Poles marked with yellow paint and black alphanumeric codes starting with a letter.
clue.br-goias-pole-id-description: Yellow-on-black painted codes starting with a digit, sometimes on plates.
clue.br-rn-pe-small-pole-plate-title: RN and PE Small Pole Plates
clue.br-rn-pe-small-pole-plate-descripti: Small yellow or orange ID plates fastened to poles in Rio Grande do Norte and Pernambuco.
clue.br-parana-pole-id-description: Poles identified by a painted black rectangle with yellow or white text.
clue.br-maranhao-embedded-pole-plate-des: Small beige numbered plates moulded into concrete poles, mostly in Maranhão.
