clue.se-diamond-tiled-roof-description: Grey diamond-shaped roof tiles are mainly found in Skåne, Blekinge, Öland, and sometimes Gotland.
clue.se-light-coloured-house-west-coast-: Light-Coloured Houses on the West Coast
The west coast has many white and light yellow houses, especially between Gothenburg and Norway.
clue.se-red-fishing-shed-west-coast-titl: Red Fishing Sheds on the West Coast
clue.se-red-fishing-shed-west-coast-desc: Dense rows of small red sheds are typical in coastal towns along the northern west coast.
clue.se-dalarna-wooden-craftsmanship-arc: Central Dalarna features red timbered houses, log portals, and distinctive "härbren" storage buildings.
clue.se-halsingland-farmhouse-descriptio: Hälsingland has large red farmhouses with many windows and long grand facades.
clue.se-octagonal-leaning-wall-shed-desc: Northern coastal agricultural sheds are octagonal or rectangular with outward-leaning red-painted log walls.
clue.se-gotland-limestone-architecture-d: Gotland houses are often limestone with dirty white facades; churches have grey or white walls with grey corners and small windows.
clue.se-oland-uneven-stone-brick-descrip: Uneven, irregular stone bricks characterize houses and rock walls on Öland.
clue.se-58-blekinge-description: Blekinge bus stop signs have a blue background with a white bus icon, often outlined in red or blue.
clue.se-58-dalarna-description: Dalarna bus stop signs have a white background with a red border and a white horse.
clue.se-58-g-vleborg-description: Gävleborg bus stop signs show a yellow background with a black bus icon.
clue.se-58-gotland-description: Gotland bus stop signs are yellow with a green border.
clue.se-58-halland-description: Halland bus stop signs feature a yellow background with a black bus icon.
clue.se-58-j-mtland-description: In Jämtland, you can spot the Länstrafiken logo on buses and bus stop signs. The logo features a stylized “Z”.
clue.se-58-j-nk-ping-description: Jönköping bus stop signs have a green background with a white bus icon.
clue.se-58-kalmar-description: In Kalmar län, you can spot the Kalmar länstrafik logo on buses and bus stop signs. The logo is a stylised heart and the busses are usually yellow and red.
clue.se-58-kronoberg-description: Kronoberg bus company is called "Länstrafiken Kronoberg".
clue.se-58-norrbotten-description: Norrbotten bus stop signs are white with a blue border and a blue bus icon.
clue.se-58-rebro-description: Örebro bus stop signs feature a yellow background with a black bus icon.
clue.se-58-sterg-tland-description: Östergötland bus stop signs are white with a blue border and a blue bus icon.
clue.se-58-sk-ne-description: In Skåne, you can spot the Skånetrafiken logo on buses and bus stop signs.
clue.se-58-s-dermanland-description: Södermanland bus stop signs have a white background with a blue border and a blue bus icon.
clue.se-58-stockholm-description: Stockholm bus stop signs are white at the bottom and red at the top with a "SL" logo.
clue.se-58-uppsala-description: Uppsala bus stop signs have a yellow and/or grey background with a black "UL" logo.
clue.se-58-v-rmland-description: In Värmland, you can spot the "Värmlandstrafiken" logo on busses and bus stops.
clue.se-58-v-sterbotten-description: Västerbotten bus stop signs are white with a blue border and a black bus icon.
clue.se-58-v-sternorrland-description: Västernorrland bus stop signs have a white background with a blue border and a blue bus icon.
clue.se-58-v-stmanland-description: In Västmanland, you can see the VL logo on buses and bus stop signs.
clue.se-58-v-stra-g-taland-description: In Västra Götaland, you can spot the Västtrafik logo on blue buses and bus stop signs
clue.se-59-stockholm-title: Stockholm County Red Wooden Bus Shelter
clue.se-59-stockholm-description: Stockholm County's bus shelters are large, red wooden structures with steep pitched roofs and open sides.
clue.se-59-v-stra-g-taland-title: Västra Götaland Red Rural Bus Shelter
clue.se-59-v-stra-g-taland-description: Västra Götaland rural bus shelters are red-painted wood with a pronounced slanted roof.
clue.se-59-sk-ne-description: Skåne rural bus shelters are red-painted wood with a sharply angled roof.
clue.se-59-uppsala-title: Uppsala County Classic Red Bus Shelter
clue.se-59-uppsala-description: Uppsala County bus shelters are large red wooden structures with steeply sloped roofs.
clue.se-59-sterg-tland-description: Östergötland rural bus shelters are red-painted wood with steeply sloped roofs.
clue.se-60-stockholm-description: Stockholm County road signs have white numbers on a blue rectangular background, usually 100–299.
clue.se-60-v-stra-g-taland-title: Västra Götaland County Road Number Signs
clue.se-60-v-stra-g-taland-description: Västra Götaland road signs are blue rectangles with white numbers, usually 40–200.
clue.se-60-sk-ne-description: Skåne road signs are blue rectangles with white numbers, frequently 9–100.
clue.se-60-uppsala-description: Uppsala County's road signs show white numbers on blue rectangles, usually 200–300.
clue.se-60-s-dermanland-description: Södermanland County uses blue rectangular signs with white numbers, commonly 50–200.
clue.se-60-sterg-tland-description: Östergötland County has blue rectangular signs with white numbers, typically 50–200.
clue.se-60-j-nk-ping-description: Jönköping County uses blue rectangular signs with white numbers, mostly 100–200.
clue.se-60-kronoberg-description: Kronoberg County's road signs are blue rectangles with white numbers, commonly 120–200.
clue.se-60-kalmar-description: Kalmar County shows road numbers on blue rectangular signs with white digits, typically 120–200.
clue.se-60-gotland-description: Gotland's road signs are blue rectangles with white numbers, often 140–150.
clue.se-60-blekinge-description: Blekinge County uses blue rectangular signs with white numbers, usually 20–120.
clue.se-60-norrbotten-description: Norrbotten County has blue rectangular signs with white numbers, commonly 300–404.
clue.se-60-v-sterbotten-description: Västerbotten County's road signs are blue rectangles with white numbers, often 300–400.
clue.se-60-v-sternorrland-description: Västernorrland County shows road numbers on blue rectangular signs with white digits, typically 300–400.
clue.se-60-j-mtland-description: Jämtland County uses blue rectangular signs with white numbers, generally 300–400.
clue.se-60-dalarna-description: Dalarna County's road signs are blue rectangles with white numbers, often 200–300.
clue.se-60-g-vleborg-description: Gävleborg County's road signs are blue rectangles with white numbers, typically 200–300.
clue.se-60-v-rmland-description: Värmland County features blue rectangular signs with white numbers, usually 200–300.
clue.se-60-rebro-description: Örebro County uses blue rectangular signs with white numbers, generally 200–300.
clue.se-60-v-stmanland-description: Västmanland County's road signs are blue rectangles with white numbers, often 200–300.
clue.se-snowmobile-trail-marker-descript: Small red crosses mark snowmobile trails throughout northern Sweden.
clue.se-red-tinted-paved-road-dalarna-de: Paved roads in western Dalarna often have a pronounced reddish colour.
clue.se-green-snow-pole-umea-description: Green snow poles occasionally appear around Umeå.
clue.se-wedge-shaped-bollard-southern-sw: Wedge-shaped bollards like those in Germany are common in southern Sweden.
clue.se-cylindrical-bollard-description: Cylindrical bollards with a horizontal black section near the top appear near the west coast, Värmland, and southern Dalarna.
clue.se-flat-bollard-northern-sweden-des: Flat bollards or cylindrical bollards with a black reflector rectangle appear on major roads in northern Sweden.
clue.se-skane-blue-red-striped-bollard-d: Small white bollards with blue or red strips near the top are found in rural Skåne.
clue.se-railway-crossing-sign-id-descrip: The back of railway crossing signs has a yellow sticker with a 5-digit ID; the first digit indicates region.
clue.se-place-name-ending-description: Certain place name suffixes are region-specific, useful for pinpointing locations.
clue.se-sami-bilingual-sign-description: Bilingual Sámi and Swedish signs appear in northern Sweden's inland areas.
clue.se-meankieli-language-sign-descript: Meänkieli appears on signs near the Finnish border, often on river names ending in "väylä."
clue.se-area-code-phone-number-descripti: Swedish landlines start with 3–4 digit area codes; the first two digits follow a regional pattern.
clue.se-mistletoe-lake-malaren-descripti: Mistletoe grows mainly near Lake Mälaren, especially in Västerås.
clue.se-orchard-kivik-description: Most of Sweden's large orchards are around Kivik on Skåne's east coast.
clue.se-slag-stone-building-bergslagen-d: Buildings partly or fully made from blue or green slag stone appear in Bergslagen.
clue.se-wooden-windmill-oland-descriptio: Numerous small grey or red wooden windmills dot Öland, which has the most windmills in Sweden.
clue.se-local-city-bus-stop-sign-descrip: Many cities and towns have unique local bus stop sign designs.
clue.se-neon-yellow-school-bus-stop-sign: Bright neon-yellow school bus stop signs are common in Linköping, Norrköping, and Jönköping.
clue.se-kungsbacka-bus-stop-blue-stripe-: Kungsbacka Bus Stops with Blue Stripes
Bus stops with three blue stripes indicate Kungsbacka municipality.
clue.se-tram-description: Trams are mainly in Gothenburg, with smaller networks in Norrköping and Stockholm.
clue.se-black-bus-shelter-vasteras-umea-: Black Bus Shelters in Västerås and Umeå
Black bus shelters with a distinctive square ridge along the back of the roof are found in both Västerås and Umeå.
clue.se-stockholm-street-sign-descriptio: Stockholm street signs have two rows separated by a black line and usually no black border.
clue.se-gothenburg-blue-street-sign-desc: Gothenburg uses distinctive blue street signs across the entire city. They almost always feature two lines of text.
clue.se-malmo-street-sign-description: Malmö uses somewhat old-looking white street signs with black corners found throughout the city.
clue.se-ystad-street-sign-description: Street signs in Ystad resemble those in Malmö but have a yellow background instead of white.
clue.se-vellinge-blue-street-sign-descri: Vellinge uses blue street signs similar to Gothenburg's but usually with one line of text.
clue.se-falkoping-yellow-street-sign-des: Plain yellow street signs are distinctive to Falköping.
clue.se-koping-blue-street-sign-descript: Blue street signs with a thin black outline are found in the town of Köping.
clue.se-dalarna-dialect-street-name-desc: Street names ending in "gattu" or "gatu" appear near Lake Siljan in central Dalarna.
clue.se-elfdalian-language-alvdalen-desc: Elfdalian appears on street signs in Älvdalen, often ending in "-ween" or "-weg."
clue.se-three-yellow-stripe-karlstad-sto: Three yellow stripes appear on signposts and street lamps in Karlstad and on traffic lights in Stockholm.
clue.se-tree-felling-advertisement-stock: Small yellow signs advertising tree felling services are common on poles in Stockholm suburbs.
clue.se-sundsvall-dragon-city-drakstaden: Sundsvall is nicknamed "Drakstaden" (the Dragon City). Dragon statues and dragon-themed signs can be spotted throughout the central parts of the city.
clue.se-country-flag-description: The national flag of Sweden is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.ch-misc-01-low-cam-description: In Switzerland the images were captured with a lower mounted camera. This brings us closer to the ground and makes the country feel different from most other.
clue.ch-direction-sign-description: Sign colour signals road class: blue for main roads, white for secondary roads.
clue.ch-pedestrian-crossing-sign-descrip: Swiss pedestrian signs are tall blue rectangles with seven stripes, a unique shape in Europe.
clue.ch-yellow-dashed-centre-line-descri: Long dashed yellow centre lines are a strong indicator of Switzerland.
clue.ch-yellow-zebra-crossing-descriptio: Pedestrian crossings in Switzerland are painted yellow.
clue.xx-road-signs-01-02-framed-signs-de: In Switzerland, many road signs have a thin metal border that gives them a clean, framed look.
clue.ch-town-entry-sign-description: Settlement name boards are white or blue with a metal frame and often show canton abbreviations.
clue.ch-chevron-description: Swiss curve warning boards are black with a white arrow; a less common inverted variant exists.
clue.ch-landscape-description: The south is mountainous with narrow valleys; the north has farmland and forested ridges.
clue.ch-architecture-description: Buildings are stone with light colours, wooden balconies, tiled gable roofs, and hinged wooden shutters.
clue.ch-bus-stop-sign-description: Bus stops have signs surrounded by a thick, tubular metal frame, unique to Switzerland.
clue.ch-four-official-languages-descript: Switzerland has German, French, Italian, and Romansh spoken in distinct zones.
clue.ch-14-canton-of-bern-description: Bern speed limit signs show 'GENERELL' above the number in German-speaking areas.
clue.ch-14-vaud-description: Vaud speed limit signs show 'GÉNÉRAL' above the number in French-speaking areas.
clue.ch-14-geneva-description: Speed limit signs show 'Limite générale' above the number in French-speaking areas.
clue.ch-14-neuch-tel-description: Neuchâtel speed limit signs show 'GÉNÉRAL' above the number in French-speaking areas.
clue.ch-14-jura-description: Jura speed limit signs show 'GÉNÉRAL' above the number in French-speaking areas.
clue.ch-14-fribourg-description: Fribourg speed limit signs show 'GENERELL' or 'GÉNÉRAL' above the number depending on language.
clue.ch-14-ticino-description: Ticino speed limit signs show 'Limite generale' above the number in Italian-speaking areas.
clue.ch-14-graub-nden-description: Graubünden speed limit signs show ‘GENERELL’, ‘GÉNÉRAL’, or ‘GENERALA’ above the number.
clue.ch-15-aargau-description: Aargau vehicles and town signs display the 'AG' code.
clue.ch-15-appenzell-ausserrhoden-descri: Vehicles and signs from Appenzell Ausserrhoden show the 'AR' code.
clue.ch-15-appenzell-innerrhoden-descrip: Vehicles and signs from Appenzell Innerrhoden show the 'AI' code.
clue.ch-15-basel-landschaft-description: The 'BL' code appears on license plates and signs in Basel-Landschaft.
clue.ch-15-basel-stadt-description: Basel-Stadt uses the 'BS' code on plates and entry signs.
clue.ch-15-bern-description: The 'BE' code identifies vehicles and locations from Bern.
clue.ch-15-fribourg-description: Vehicles and signs from Fribourg use the 'FR' code.
clue.ch-15-geneva-description: The 'GE' code marks license plates and signs in Geneva.
clue.ch-15-glarus-description: Glarus vehicles and signs show the 'GL' code.
clue.ch-15-graub-nden-description: The 'GR' code identifies the canton of Graubünden.
clue.ch-15-jura-description: Jura vehicles and signs feature the 'JU' code.
clue.ch-15-luzern-description: The 'LU' code is used on license plates and entry signs in Luzern.
clue.ch-15-neuch-tel-description: Neuchâtel vehicles and town signs display the 'NE' abbreviation.
clue.ch-15-nidwalden-description: The 'NW' code on license plates and entry signs marks Nidwalden.
clue.ch-15-obwalden-description: Obwalden is identified by the 'OW' code on license plates and entry signs.
clue.ch-15-schaffhausen-description: The 'SH' abbreviation is used on plates and signs in Schaffhausen.
clue.ch-15-schwyz-description: Schwyz vehicles and entry signs are marked with the 'SZ' code.
clue.ch-15-solothurn-description: The 'SO' code on license plates and town signs is used for Solothurn.
clue.ch-15-st-gallen-description: St. Gallen is represented by the 'SG' code on license plates and entry signs.
clue.ch-15-ticino-description: The 'TI' abbreviation marks vehicles and entry signs from Ticino.
clue.ch-15-thurgau-description: Thurgau vehicles and town signs display the 'TG' code.
clue.ch-15-uri-description: The 'UR' code is used on license plates and entry signs in Uri.
clue.ch-15-valais-description: Valais is represented by the 'VS' code on plates and town entry signs.
clue.ch-15-vaud-description: Vehicles and entry signs from Vaud start with 'VD'.
clue.ch-15-zug-description: The 'ZG' code on license plates and entry signs is unique to Zug.
clue.ch-15-z-rich-description: Zürich vehicles and town signs display the 'ZH' code.
clue.ch-postal-code-region-description: Swiss postal codes' leading digits follow a west-to-east pattern to narrow down your region.
clue.ch-high-alpine-south-description: Southern cantons have tall, rugged Alpine peaks with deep valleys.
clue.ch-modest-northern-hills-descriptio: Northern cantons feature gentler terrain with modest hills and lower mountains.
clue.ch-jura-mountains-description: Flat terrain with a chain of mid-height, forested mountains along the northwest horizon indicates the Jura.
clue.ch-jura-limestone-outcrop-descripti: Bare limestone rock faces jutting from wooded hillsides are typical of the Jura mountains.
clue.ch-rock-wall-description: Dry-stone walls along roads and fields are common in the Jura and Italian-speaking Alps.
clue.ch-italian-style-architecture-ticin: Orange-yellow walls, terracotta roofs, and Italian shutters indicate Ticino.
clue.ch-bernese-arch-house-description: Bern farmhouses have massive roofs with undersides curving into a pronounced arch.
clue.ch-northeastern-timber-framing-desc: Ornate, often red timber-framed buildings are typical of northeastern Switzerland.
clue.ch-appenzell-house-style-descriptio: Appenzell houses join living quarters to barns at a 90° roof angle with facades subdivided into window-framing squares.
clue.ch-graubunden-stone-house-descripti: Graubünden houses are stone-built with white painted motifs around windows and edges.
clue.ch-vaud-oversized-town-sign-descrip: Unusually large town entry signs appear in Vaud.
clue.ch-basel-landschaft-olive-green-inf: Signposts and sign borders painted olive green indicate Basel-Landschaft.
clue.ch-valais-wooden-bollard-descriptio: Thick wooden bollards, square or cylindrical, are common in Valais.
clue.ch-glarus-fence-reflector-descripti: In Glarus, reflectors are mounted directly on roadside fences.
clue.ch-geneva-bike-path-symbol-descript: Cycle path markings in Geneva and the valley between Martigny and Lake Geneva show a simplified stick figure atop two disconnected wheels.
clue.ch-road-divider-type-description: Distinct road divider and lane-marker styles vary across regions.
clue.ch-other-fruit-tree-area-descriptio: Fruit orchards are common near Lake Constance and northwest of Lake Geneva.
clue.ch-country-flag-description: The national flag of Switzerland is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.tw-double-yellow-centre-lines-descr: Most Taiwanese roads have double yellow centre lines with single white edge lines.
clue.tw-white-edge-lines-no-centre-title: White Edge Lines Without Centre Lines
clue.tw-white-edge-lines-no-centre-descr: Roads with only white edge lines and no centre marking are common in Taiwan.
clue.tw-black-yellow-chevrons-descriptio: Taiwanese chevrons have black arrows on a yellow background.
clue.tw-orange-hooded-mirrors-descriptio: Convex road mirrors with bright orange hoods are common at Taiwanese intersections and bends.
clue.tw-concrete-drainage-ditches-descri: Open concrete drainage channels run alongside many Taiwanese roads.
clue.tw-distribution-transformers-descri: Box-shaped distribution transformers, usually dark green or grey, appear frequently in Taiwanese urban areas.
clue.tw-architecture-description: Taiwanese residential buildings range from cramped multi-storey to flat single-storey homes, often boxy with white tile walls and light-green tin sheds.
clue.tw-county-map-offshore-islands-desc: Taiwan includes distant island groups: Kinmen, Lienchiang, Penghu, Green Island, and Orchid Island.
clue.tw-telephone-area-codes-description: Taiwanese phone numbers have two-digit area codes (02–08) increasing from north to south. Mobile numbers start with 09.
clue.tw-national-freeway-system-descript: Taiwan's odd-numbered freeways run north–south, even-numbered run east–west, with numbers increasing west to east and north to south.
clue.tw-township-road-signs-county-descr: Taiwanese township road signs show a Chinese character indicating the county before or above the road number.
clue.tw-blue-pole-plaques-grid-coordinat: Blue plaques on poles encode precise coordinates with a letter for a grid rectangle and four digits for position within it.
clue.tw-central-western-plains-descripti: Flat to gently rolling agricultural land dominates Taiwan's central western lowlands.
clue.tw-central-eastern-mountains-descri: Forested mountains cover two-thirds of Taiwan with temperate or coniferous trees at higher elevations.
clue.tw-hualien-taitung-valley-descripti: A long, narrow north–south valley on the east coast between Hualien and Taitung, with flat plains between forested mountains.
clue.tw-yilan-plain-description: A plain enclosed by mountains on three sides, featuring rice paddies and houses beside fields.
clue.tw-kinmen-fuzzy-leaved-trees-descri: Roads lined with trees bearing fuzzy foliage and red-tinged soil identify Kinmen Island.
clue.tw-miaoli-hsinchu-low-rolling-hills: Miaoli and Hsinchu, Low Rolling Hills
Gently rolling terrain with winding roads and sparse farmland.
clue.tw-areca-palm-central-southern-taiw: Areca Palms, Central and Southern Taiwan
Areca (betel nut) palms grow extensively in mountainous areas of central and southern Taiwan.
clue.tw-coconut-palm-southern-coast-desc: Coconut palms concentrate near the southern coast.
clue.tw-leafless-tree-penghu-description: Bare, leafless trees are common on Penghu.
clue.tw-coastal-fish-farm-western-counti: Cultivated fish ponds line the western coast from Yunlin to Pingtung.
clue.tw-tea-plantation-description: Tea plantations appear in mountainous areas, especially Chiayi, Nantou, Hsinchu, and Miaoli.
clue.tw-areca-palm-plantation-pingtung-d: Neat rows of areca palms on flat plains characterize Pingtung County.
clue.tw-dense-urban-housing-northern-tai: Older, disorganized housing and tall, dingy apartment blocks are common in northern urban areas.
clue.tw-red-brick-building-taoyuan-descr: Red brick and red tile apartment buildings are frequent in Taoyuan.
clue.tw-luxury-villa-yilan-description: Multi-storey, often gated villas characterize parts of Yilan.
clue.tw-cream-coloured-house-penghu-desc: White-tinged cream-colored residential buildings are common on Penghu.
clue.tw-traditional-house-kinmen-descrip: Small traditional-style houses with characteristic rooflines appear on Kinmen.
clue.tw-lamppost-location-sticker-descri: Stickers on lampposts encode location data, similar to blue pole plaques on utility poles.
clue.tw-white-speckled-pavement-east-coa: Road surfaces with visible white speckles are common along the eastern coast.
clue.tw-red-white-striped-lamppost-kinme: Lampposts with diagonal red-and-white stripes appear frequently on Kinmen.
clue.tw-trapezoidal-base-lamppost-kaohsi: Lampposts with red-and-white stripes on a trapezoidal base are prevalent in Kaohsiung.
clue.tw-thick-pole-top-support-yunlin-de: Utility poles with thicker-than-usual supports below the pole top are found in Yunlin.
clue.tw-green-square-sticker-chiayi-city: Green square stickers appear on nearly every pole in Chiayi City.
clue.tw-bent-chevron-holder-southern-cou: Curved sign and chevron holders with black-and-yellow-striped stickers appear in Pingtung, Kaohsiung, and Taitung.
clue.tw-country-flag-description: The national flag of Taiwan is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.tz-extremely-limited-coverage-descr: Tanzania has very sparse coverage: trekkers in Gombe National Park, some on Mount Kilimanjaro, and spill coverage from the Kenyan border.
clue.tz-country-flag-description: The national flag of Tanzania is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.th-road-01-driving-direction-descri: In Thailand they drive on the left side of the road.
clue.th-bollard-description: Thai bollards are square with a pointed top and painted in alternating black-and-white stripes.
clue.th-concrete-road-description: Paved concrete surfaces in Thailand typically display a large square-tile pattern.
clue.th-utility-pole-description: Thai utility poles are square-profiled concrete with a vertical row of small pinholes up the shaft.
clue.th-language-01-small-circles-descri: In the written Thai language there is a lot of small circles on the letters.
clue.th-yellow-centre-line-description: Thai road centre markings are yellow, either solid or dashed lines.
clue.th-street-light-pole-marking-descri: The base of street light poles is painted with red-and-black or black-and-white stripes.
clue.th-overhanging-lamp-post-descriptio: Thai lamp posts are long and slender, arcing outward over the roadway.
clue.th-directional-road-sign-descriptio: Minor-road directional signs are white with two stacked panels; highways have green signs often with romanised names.
clue.th-road-signs-01-stop-signs-descrip: In Thailand the stop signs are written in Thai.
clue.th-garuda-road-marker-description: Thai route-number markers feature a white or black Garuda symbol; national routes are white-and-black shields, provincial routes blue-and-yellow.
clue.th-green-village-sign-description: Distinctive small green signs are widespread, especially in rural villages.
clue.th-black-utility-box-province-code-: Black Utility Boxes with Province Codes
Small black boxes on utility infrastructure display a three-letter province code in two formats.
clue.th-muslim-community-deep-south-desc: Islamic culture is concentrated in Thailand's southernmost provinces with mosques and Jawi script.
clue.th-flat-dry-landscape-description: Two regions north and east of Bangkok are noticeably flat and arid.
clue.th-tall-mountain-northwest-descript: High mountain terrain is concentrated in northwestern Thailand.
clue.th-low-forested-mountain-centre-nor: Gently rounded, densely forested hills appear in the centre-north of the country.
clue.th-exposed-rock-mountain-descriptio: Steep, rocky mountain faces with exposed rock are mostly in western Thailand and the southern peninsula.
clue.th-red-soil-description: Reddish earth is most prevalent in the northeast (Isan).
clue.th-rubber-plantation-description: Rubber tree plantations are concentrated in the south, identifiable by black tapping cups near trunks.
clue.th-rice-cultivation-zone-descriptio: Most of Thailand's rice farming takes place within the highlighted region.
clue.th-dry-season-rice-central-plains-d: Dry-season rice is common on the central plains, often with hazy skies from wildfire smoke.
clue.th-wet-season-rice-eastern-plains-d: Wet-season rice paddies are concentrated in the eastern lowlands.
clue.th-palm-oil-plantation-description: Palm oil plantations are heavily concentrated on the southern peninsula.
clue.th-short-coconut-palm-plantation-de: Dense groves of short to medium coconut palms are common west of Bangkok.
clue.th-palmyra-palm-description: Large clusters of palmyra palms are typical of the eastern peninsula coast and far south.
clue.th-sugar-cane-field-description: Sugar cane cultivation is mainly in central and eastern Thailand.
clue.th-cassava-field-description: Cassava, a shrubby plant with hand-shaped leaves, is common on central and northeastern plains.
clue.th-corn-field-description: Maize cultivation is concentrated in northern and central regions.
clue.th-durian-plantation-description: Durian orchards near Chanthaburi and the peninsula have cone-shaped young trees and mature trees with dark bark and pointed leaves.
clue.th-pineapple-plantation-description: Pineapple farms are concentrated southeast and southwest of Bangkok.
clue.th-teak-tree-description: Teak grows mainly in the north, recognizable by large leaves and yellow flowers.
clue.th-pine-tree-tenasserim-pine-descri: Pinus latteri is found almost exclusively in the north and northwest.
clue.th-garden-croton-description: Garden croton is an ornamental shrub with vivid yellow, orange, and red foliage, thriving around Ranong and coastal provinces.
clue.th-gray-corrugated-metal-roof-descr: Gray corrugated metal roofing is most frequent in northern and southern regions.
clue.th-indented-utility-pole-bangkok-de: Poles with a Chilean-style vertical indent are typical near Bangkok.
clue.th-wind-turbine-description: Wind farms are on western flanks of Chaiyaphum and Nakhon Ratchasima, and eastern coast in Songkhla and Nakhon Si Thammarat.
clue.th-insulator-7-plus-ridges-descript: Power-line insulators with seven or more ridges appear in the southern peninsula and highways in Chiang Rai and Phayao.
clue.th-single-insulator-crossbar-descri: Poles with one insulator on the crossbar are found from Ranong and Chumphon southward.
clue.th-two-insulator-crossbar-descripti: Poles with two insulators on the crossbar are common outside the southern peninsula.
clue.th-country-flag-description: The national flag of Thailand is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.tn-olive-tree-plantation-descriptio: Neatly arranged rows of olive trees on raked, weed-free soil frequently line Tunisian roads.
clue.tn-white-road-line-description: Tunisian roads typically have white road lines.
clue.tn-white-directional-sign-descripti: Tunisian directional signs have a white background with town names in Arabic and Latin script.
clue.tn-traditional-blue-paint-building-: Doors, windows, gates, and other architectural elements are sometimes painted in a distinctive traditional blue.
clue.tn-red-white-striped-kerb-descripti: Red-and-white striped kerbs are common on Tunisian roads.
clue.tn-concrete-road-marker-coloured-to: Concrete Road Markers with Coloured Tops
White concrete markers with rounded red, yellow, or green tops are found throughout Tunisia.
clue.tn-bilingual-stop-sign-description: Tunisian stop signs feature both Arabic and Latin text.
clue.tn-light-green-toyota-follow-car-no: A light green Toyota follow car appears throughout northern Tunisia, never seen south of Hammamet.
clue.tn-dark-green-mazda-follow-car-hamm: The dark green Mazda is Tunisia's most common follow car, found from Hammamet south to Djerba, with a military licence plate featuring a red strip on the left.
clue.tn-multiple-follow-car-tunis-descri: Follow cars in the capital Tunis vary, but most of them are carrying a red beacon on the roof.
clue.tn-country-flag-description: The national flag of Tunisia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.tr-european-licence-plates-blue-str: Turkish licence plates are white, elongated European format with a blue vertical strip on the left.
clue.tr-mixed-white-yellow-road-lines-ti: Mixed White and Yellow Road Lines
clue.tr-mixed-white-yellow-road-lines-de: In Turkey, road markings vary between white and yellow, sometimes mixed on the same stretch.
clue.tr-divided-highways-prevalence-desc: Turkey has a high rate of dual-carriageway roads.
clue.tr-red-white-chevron-signs-descript: Turkish chevron signs are red arrows on a white background, often with a neon yellow border.
clue.tr-black-yellow-upward-chevron-desc: Intersections often have black-and-yellow chevron panels with upward-pointing arrows.
clue.tr-narrow-red-white-chevrons-descri: A slim Turkish chevron variant uses red-and-white colors.
clue.tr-wide-spaced-font-direction-signs: Turkish directional signs use a typeface with large gaps between letters.
clue.xx-general-01-39-stop-signs-descrip: In Turkey, stop signs say "DUR", which is unique to the country.
clue.tr-ladder-mesh-metal-poles-descript: Metal utility poles with ladder or mesh-grid patterns are widespread in Turkey.
clue.tr-varied-landscape-regions-descrip: Turkey's terrain ranges from arid southeast plains to Mediterranean coasts and greener northern forests.
clue.tr-boxy-apartment-blocks-descriptio: Tall, cube-shaped apartment buildings are common in Turkish cities and towns.
clue.tr-interlocking-brick-pavements-des: Sidewalks and pedestrian areas often use interlocking bricks in a repeating shape.
clue.tr-telephone-area-codes-region-desc: Turkish area codes rise from 2 in the west to 4 in the east, indicating general location.
clue.tr-numbered-road-system-description: Major highways have 'O-' prefixes on kilometre markers; D-roads show three-digit numbers with section and kilometre counts.
clue.tr-provincial-road-km-markers-descr: Provincial road markers start with two digits representing the province code.
clue.tr-lush-green-landscape-north-title: Lush Green Landscape in the North
clue.tr-lush-green-landscape-north-descr: Northern coastal Turkey is greener and more densely forested than other regions.
clue.tr-northeastern-treeless-grassland-: The northeast has open valleys of grass between rounded, treeless hills.
clue.tr-turkish-pines-mediterranean-coas: Turkish Pines Along the Mediterranean Coast
Turkish pines grow mainly along the Mediterranean coast.
clue.tr-tea-plantations-rize-description: Terraced tea fields are a hallmark of Rize Province along the northeastern Black Sea coast.
clue.tr-olive-trees-mediterranean-coast-: Olive Trees on the Mediterranean Coast
Olive groves are concentrated along Turkey's Mediterranean shoreline.
clue.tr-sunflower-fields-northwest-descr: Large sunflower plantations are typical in northwestern Turkey.
clue.tr-vineyards-east-izmir-description: Most Turkish vineyards lie inland east of Izmir.
clue.tr-cotton-fields-sanliurfa-descript: Cotton cultivation is concentrated around the city of Sanliurfa in the southeast.
clue.tr-lake-van-semi-arid-surroundings-: Lake Van and Its Semi-Arid Surroundings
Turkey's largest lake sits within a semi-arid basin of dry grassy hills, with scattered trees and pockets of farmland closer to the shoreline.
clue.tr-dark-volcanic-rock-sanliurfa-diy: Dark Volcanic Rock Between Sanliurfa and Diyarbakir
Dark basaltic rock formations are widespread in the area stretching between Sanliurfa and Diyarbakir.
clue.tr-steep-rocky-river-valleys-descri: Deep river gorges with rocky cliffs occur in northeast and far southeast Turkey.
clue.tr-flat-roofs-southeast-description: Flat-roofed buildings dominate southeastern Turkey and parts of the southern coast.
clue.tr-metal-roofs-east-description: Sheet metal roofing is common in eastern Turkey.
clue.tr-yellow-black-chevrons-balikesir-: Yellow arrows on black chevrons appear mainly around Balikesir and Kars provinces.
clue.tr-black-yellow-chevrons-north-izmi: Black arrows on yellow chevrons are common north of Izmir.
clue.tr-divided-highways-no-physical-div: Four-lane highways separated only by painted double lines occur mostly in eastern Turkey.
clue.tr-vertical-water-tanks-description: Upright cylindrical water tanks are common throughout most of Turkey.
clue.tr-stacked-horizontal-vertical-wate: A horizontal tank atop a vertical tank is typical along the south coast extending inland toward Elazig.
clue.tr-square-water-tanks-angled-corner: Square Water Tanks with Angled Corners
Boxy water tanks with bevelled corners appear in the southern zone between Iskenderun and Sanliurfa.
clue.tr-white-spherical-water-tanks-batm: White Spherical Water Tanks Near Batman
White ball-shaped water tanks cluster in the southeast, south of Batman.
clue.tr-six-digit-pole-codes-european-tu: In European Turkey, utility poles carry a six-digit code below the yellow electrical warning sign.
clue.tr-ankara-street-signs-blue-round-t: Street name plates in Ankara Province are blue with a small semicircular cap at the top.
clue.tr-izmir-street-signs-curved-dark-b: Izmir street signs are dark blue, convex, and usually feature the white Izmir emblem at the top.
clue.tr-greenhouses-west-adana-descripti: Dense clusters of greenhouses mark the southern coast west of Adana.
clue.tr-whitewashed-buildings-bodrum-des: Bodrum features whitewashed flat-roofed buildings often accented with blue trim or natural stonework.
clue.tr-cappadocia-rock-formations-gorem: The town of Goreme, located west of Kayseri, is unmistakable thanks to towering sandstone pillars with ancient cave dwellings carved into their faces.
clue.tr-mount-ararat-agri-dagi-descripti: Turkey's highest peak is a dormant volcano in the far east, often visible with a smaller cone (Kucuk Agri).
clue.tr-banana-plants-alanya-description: Banana plantations are localised around the coastal city of Alanya.
clue.tr-light-blue-tourist-signs-bozcaad: Light-Blue Tourist Signs on Bozcaada Island
Bozcaada island uses distinctive light-blue and grey tourist information signs, shaped either as arrows or as rectangles with a rounded top.
clue.tr-istanbul-street-sign-arrow-descr: Red street name plates with a coloured bottom strip are used in multiple Turkish cities. A white arrow in the lower-right corner pointing in both directions with a single arrowhead is a strong indicator of Istanbul specifically.
clue.tr-red-oval-street-signs-trabzon-ya: Red Oval Street Signs in Trabzon and Yalvac
Trabzon and Yalvac share a distinctive red, oval-shaped street sign design. House number plates follow the same styling.
clue.tr-green-street-signs-bursa-descrip: Bursa's street name plates are green with slightly raised lettering, giving the surface a textured, three-dimensional feel.
clue.tr-green-borderless-street-signs-bo: Green Borderless Street Signs in Bolu
Street signs in Bolu are also green, but they are completely flat and have no border or frame around the edges.
clue.tr-country-flag-description: The national flag of Turkey is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.ug-palm-tree-north-description: Palm trees in Ugandan coverage indicate the northern section of Murchison Falls.
clue.ug-water-filled-crater-description: Large water-filled craters appear in the northern coverage of the park.
clue.ug-country-flag-description: The national flag of Uganda is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.xx-general-01-50-red-car-descriptio: In Ukraine, you will most often see the back of a red Google car.
clue.ua-poor-road-quality-description: Ukraine has some of the worst roads in Europe, with rural roads full of potholes and cracks.
clue.ua-ukrainian-cyrillic-script-descri: Ukrainian uses Cyrillic with unique letters: Є є, Ґ ґ, І і, and Ї ї.
clue.ua-word-street-vul-description: The Ukrainian word for street is вулиця, abbreviated вул.
clue.ua-word-city-m-description: The Ukrainian word for city is місто, abbreviated м.
clue.ua-white-town-entry-sign-descriptio: Ukrainian town entry signs are white.
clue.ua-square-concrete-utility-pole-des: Ukraine uses square concrete utility poles with various tops, sometimes white-painted bases.
clue.ua-diagonal-pole-support-beam-descr: Utility poles often have diagonal support beams.
clue.ua-wooden-pole-concrete-base-descri: Wooden utility poles with concrete bases appear in Ukraine.
clue.ua-red-chevron-white-arrow-descript: Ukrainian chevrons are red with white arrows.
clue.ua-three-stripe-pedestrian-sign-des: Pedestrian crossing signs show three stripes.
clue.ua-black-white-guardrail-descriptio: Guardrails and barriers are often painted black and white.
clue.ua-soviet-era-apartment-block-descr: Cities feature large Soviet-era apartment blocks of light grey brick or concrete prefab.
clue.ua-rundown-suburban-home-descriptio: Suburbs have vegetated areas with single-family brick houses, corrugated roofs, fenced yards, and mostly unpaved roads.
clue.ua-typical-rural-scenery-descriptio: Rural Ukraine has poor roads, flat to hilly terrain, roadside trees, open farmland, little infrastructure, and low traffic.
clue.ua-summer-coverage-description: Most Ukrainian coverage was shot in summer.
clue.ua-tall-poplar-tree-description: Tall, columnar poplar trees are common across Ukraine.
clue.ua-ultra-rural-track-near-city-desc: Ultra-rural dirt tracks near cities appear commonly in Ukraine.
clue.ua-oblast-internet-domain-descripti: Oblast-specific second-level domains (e.g. .te.ua) appear on signs and are mostly intuitive.
clue.ua-carpathian-mountain-description: Western Ukraine's Carpathians are hillier and forested with pine trees and curving roads.
clue.ua-baltic-pine-forest-north-title: Baltic Pine Forests in the North
clue.ua-baltic-pine-forest-north-descrip: Northern Ukraine near Belarus has forests of tall Baltic pines with orange-red bark.
clue.ua-drier-landscape-south-descriptio: Southern Ukraine is warmer and drier with shrubs and open fields.
clue.ua-blooming-sunflower-field-south-e: Blooming Sunflower Fields in the South and East
Blooming sunflower fields appear mainly in southern and eastern Ukraine by late July.
clue.ua-russian-language-east-south-titl: Russian Language in the East and South
clue.ua-russian-language-east-south-desc: Russian text appears in eastern and southern Ukraine with letters Ы ы and Э э.
clue.ua-polish-style-bollard-zakarpattia: Bollards with red reflectors wrapping around appear in Zakarpattia Oblast.
clue.ua-hungarian-language-border-descri: Near the Hungarian border, signs are bilingual or monolingual Hungarian.
clue.ua-country-flag-description: The national flag of Ukraine is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.xx-general-01-06-emirati-road-lines: In the UAE, outer road lines are yellow, while the center lines can be white or yellow.
clue.ae-arabic-english-description: Signage in the UAE is bilingual, with Arabic script alongside English.
clue.ae-striped-signpost-description: In the UAE, signposts often have alternating black-and-white stripes.
clue.ae-striped-kerb-description: In the UAE, kerbs are often painted with black-and-white or black-and-yellow stripes.
clue.ae-divided-road-roundabout-descript: Divided roads and roundabouts are very common in the UAE.
clue.ae-electricity-pole-description: Emirati utility poles are dark brown wood topped with three insulators on a horizontal metal bar.
clue.ae-coverage-area-description: UAE Street View coverage is concentrated in the northeast.
clue.ae-eastern-mountain-description: Mountains in the UAE appear only in the far east.
clue.ae-dubai-blue-street-sign-descripti: Street name signs in Dubai are blue with a thin metal border, not seen elsewhere in the UAE.
clue.ae-country-flag-description: Horizontal stripes of green, white, and black with a vertical red band on the left.
clue.gb-double-yellow-road-line-descript: Paired yellow lines along the kerbside mark no-stopping zones in towns and cities.
clue.gb-standard-bollard-description: Squat, barrel-shaped posts with black base and cap separated by a white band; red reflector faces traffic, white faces away.
clue.gb-wooden-pole-with-step-descriptio: Timber utility poles have thin horizontal metal rungs bolted up one side.
clue.gb-chevron-sign-description: Curve warning boards use white arrows on a black background.
clue.gb-triangular-warning-sign-descript: Warning signs are red-bordered triangles on a white background.
clue.gb-direction-sign-description: Directional signs are blue (motorways), green (primary routes), and white (local roads), with 'A', 'M', or 'B' prefixes.
clue.gb-white-street-sign-description: Low-mounted white plaques with black lettering, often on two short posts; suburban versions may show cul-de-sac pictograms.
clue.gb-give-way-sign-description: Inverted-triangle yield signs read 'GIVE WAY' in large text.
clue.gb-pole-warning-sticker-description: Yellow hazard stickers on utility poles depict a human figure struck by lightning.
clue.gb-yellow-traffic-bollard-descripti: Yellow reflective panels on traffic-island bollards indicate which side traffic should pass.
clue.gb-square-cornered-metal-gate-descr: Farm gates made from tubular metal with square-angled corners.
clue.gb-green-countryside-hedgerow-descr: Rural areas have green pastures, dense hedgerows lining narrow lanes, and rolling hills.
clue.gb-red-brick-building-description: Red brick construction is common in residential and commercial buildings.
clue.gb-suburban-layout-description: Residential estates have rows of near-identical semi-detached homes with manicured gardens and cul-de-sacs.
clue.gb-chimney-pot-description: Brick chimney stacks topped with multiple cylindrical terracotta pots.
clue.gb-black-white-timber-framing-descr: Buildings feature black timber frames against white-rendered walls.
clue.gb-country-flag-description: Flags of England, Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland appear on buildings or flagpoles.
clue.gb-23-cornwall-england-description: Major A-roads start with '3' (e.g. A30, A39) on green signs with white numbers.
clue.gb-23-devon-england-description: Main A-roads start with '3' (e.g. A38, A377) on green signs with white numbers.
clue.gb-23-dorset-england-description: Primary A-roads start with '3' (e.g. A35, A354) on green signs with white numbers.
clue.gb-23-somerset-england-description: Major A-roads start with '3' (e.g. A37, A361) on green signs with white numbers.
clue.gb-23-wiltshire-england-description: Main A-roads start with '3' (e.g. A303, A346) on green signs with white numbers.
clue.gb-23-gloucestershire-england-descr: Major A-roads start with '4' (e.g. A40, A417) on green signs with white numbers.
clue.gb-23-bristol-england-description: Primary A-roads start with '4' (e.g. A4, A432) on green signs with white numbers.
clue.gb-23-cumbria-england-description: In Cumbria, major A-roads typically start with '6', such as A66 or A685. Signs are green with bold white digits, sometimes outlined in white.
clue.gb-23-cheshire-england-description: Cheshire's main A-roads often begin with '5' or '6', such as A56 or A534. Signs are green with large white numbers, sometimes outlined in white.
clue.gb-23-lancashire-england-descriptio: Lancashire's major A-roads usually start with '5' or '6', such as A59 or A683. Signs are green with bold white numbers, sometimes outlined in white.
clue.gb-23-greater-manchester-england-de: Greater Manchester's primary A-roads typically start with '5' or '6', such as A56 or A635. Signs are green with prominent white numbers, sometimes bordered in white.
clue.gb-23-merseyside-england-descriptio: Merseyside's main A-roads are generally in the '5' series, such as A580 or A5036. Signs are green with large white numbers, sometimes outlined in white.
clue.gb-23-northern-ireland-description: In Northern Ireland, A-roads can start with any digit from 1 to 8, such as A1 or A6. Signs are green with white numbers, sometimes with a white border.
clue.gb-phone-area-code-description: Landline numbers start with 0 followed by nine or ten digits; the first two to four digits form the area code.
clue.gb-city-name-bin-description: Public rubbish bins in urban areas often display the local council or city name.
clue.gb-scottish-highland-landscape-desc: Open, semi-barren terrain with imposing mountains characterises the Highlands, often brown and yellow in early spring.
clue.gb-scottish-red-white-bollard-descr: Chunky, round-topped bollards with a red-and-grey reflective band encircling the post appear mainly in Scotland.
clue.gb-scottish-passing-place-sign-desc: Diamond-shaped white signs reading 'Passing Place' are exclusive to Scotland's single-track roads.
clue.gb-welsh-language-description: Welsh appears alongside English on road signs throughout Wales, identifiable by D, W, Y, and the double-L digraph (Ll).
clue.gb-araf-road-marking-description: The word 'Araf' (Welsh for 'Slow') painted on roads alongside English is found only in Wales.
clue.gb-scottish-gaelic-language-descrip: A Celtic language with accent marks and clusters like bh, dh, fh, mh, ai, ea, eo, and ui. Bilingual signs appear mainly north of Glasgow.
clue.gb-cornish-palm-description: Cabbage trees (Cordyline australis), called Cornish palms, are most common along southwest England's coast and Jersey.
clue.gb-northern-ireland-lamppost-sticke: Small black stickers with yellow text sometimes appear on street lights in Northern Ireland.
clue.gb-london-street-sign-description: London's distinctive street plaques show the road name in black lettering, with the postcode and borough name printed in red beneath.
clue.um-albatross-everywhere-description: Albatrosses are present in nearly every location on Midway Atoll.
clue.um-runway-coverage-description: Much of Midway Atoll coverage is on two runways, where albatrosses may be scarce.
clue.um-other-islands-trekker-coverage-d: Islands beyond Midway have trekker coverage, low bushy vegetation, and many birds.
clue.um-well-paved-east-west-runway-desc: A nicely paved east-west runway runs on the southern side of Midway Atoll.
clue.um-deteriorating-north-south-runway: A north-south runway on Midway has poor pavement worsening toward the north.
clue.um-small-village-eastern-midway-des: A small settlement is on the eastern side of Midway Atoll.
clue.um-southeast-island-description: The least distinctive island, with a small central lake and many birds in the sky.
clue.um-lisianski-island-large-bush-desc: Lisianski Island coverage is along the shoreline, encircled by large bushes.
clue.um-laysan-island-clear-skies-descri: Laysan Island coverage has almost no cloud cover.
clue.um-french-frigate-shoals-most-birds: A long, thin island with a shabby runway and the highest bird density in the chain.
clue.um-western-runway-corner-most-commo: Western Runway Corner, Most Common Spawn
The western corner of Midway Atoll runway is a common GeoGuessr spawn location.
clue.um-country-flag-description: The national flag of the US Minor Outlying Islands is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.uy-typical-landscape-weather-descri: Overcast skies over open grasslands with gentle hills and occasional tree plantations.
clue.uy-plain-white-licence-plate-descri: Uruguayan licence plates are plain white with black text.
clue.uy-smudgy-camera-quality-descriptio: Much of Uruguay's coverage has a somewhat smudgy camera quality.
clue.xx-general-01-27-triple-road-lines-: In Uruguay, you can find triple road markings, double yellow lines with a white dashed line running between them.
clue.uy-other-road-line-pattern-descript: Yellow-white lines and plain white lines also appear in Uruguay.
clue.uy-other-pole-design-description: Uruguay also features round poles with flat metal-sheet tops, square concrete poles, simple wooden poles with a single insulator, and occasionally Argentine-style poles.
clue.uy-guardrail-support-description: Uruguayan guardrails have small rectangular yellow or red reflectors and uniquely shaped supports.
clue.uy-green-stone-kilometre-marker-des: Green-painted stone kilometre markers are unique to Uruguay.
clue.uy-yellow-black-chevron-description: Uruguayan chevrons are yellow with black arrows.
clue.uy-gently-hilly-terrain-description: Most of Uruguay has subtle, gentle hills despite low overall elevation. Roads almost always have at least a slight incline.
clue.uy-reddish-soil-description: Reddish soil, from light pink to deep red, appears in many parts of Uruguay.
clue.uy-concrete-cube-shaped-house-descr: Many Uruguayan houses are concrete and cube-shaped, with drab, weathered walls and flat roofs.
clue.uy-short-stocky-palm-tree-descripti: Short, stocky palm trees occasionally appear in Uruguay's countryside.
clue.uy-widespread-cattle-description: Cattle outnumber people four to one, making livestock very common in rural Uruguay.
clue.uy-elevation-difference-description: Uruguay's highest hills are near Minas east of Montevideo and north of Tacuarembo.
clue.uy-rocky-hill-near-minas-descriptio: The Minas area has some of Uruguay's tallest hills with exposed rock and heavy bushland.
clue.uy-dark-soiled-northern-hill-descri: Northern hills have darker soil than Minas and typically lack exposed rock, with common vegetation and tree plantations.
clue.uy-tree-plantation-north-descriptio: Commercial tree plantations are common, especially in northern and northwestern Uruguay.
clue.uy-country-flag-description: The national flag of Uruguay is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.vu-location-description: Vanuatu is a Pacific island nation northeast of Brisbane, between the Solomon Islands, New Caledonia, and Fiji.
clue.vu-dark-volcanic-soil-description: Vanuatu's volcanic island has dark volcanic soil frequently appearing along paths.
clue.vu-dense-tropical-forest-descriptio: Much of Vanuatu's coverage passes through dense tropical forest.
clue.vu-black-sand-beach-description: A beach with black volcanic sand appears on the east side of Ambrym Island.
clue.xx-general-01-31-vietnamese-languag: The Vietnamese language is written in a modified Latin script that features an extensive system of diacritical marks.
clue.vn-red-white-striped-signpost-descr: Vietnamese road sign posts are usually painted with red-and-white stripes.
clue.vn-yellow-orange-road-sign-descript: Vietnamese road signs have a yellow-orange background.
clue.vn-waystone-coloured-top-descriptio: Vietnamese waystones are white with red or blue tops, showing road numbers and distances.
clue.vn-single-arrow-chevron-description: Vietnamese chevrons are black-on-yellow or white-on-red, typically with a single arrow.
clue.vn-blue-directional-sign-descriptio: Vietnamese directional signs are blue with thin or no white borders and white arrows.
clue.vn-short-yellow-centre-dash-descrip: Short yellow dashes as centre road lines are common and distinctive in Vietnam.
clue.vn-concrete-block-road-description: Minor Vietnamese roads are often made of concrete blocks.
clue.vn-red-white-concrete-safety-barrie: Red-and-white striped concrete barriers are common on Vietnamese mountain roads.
clue.vn-holey-concrete-pole-description: Concrete poles with rows of holes, on the lower half or nearly to the top, are common in Vietnam.
clue.vn-round-pole-pin-hole-description: Vietnam often has round concrete poles with indents and small pin holes near the top.
clue.vn-inverted-trapezoid-pole-top-desc: Pole tops shaped like upside-down trapezoids are common in Vietnam.
clue.vn-double-pole-description: Double utility poles of various designs are fairly common in Vietnam.
clue.vn-grain-drying-road-description: In Vietnam, grains are often spread out on road surfaces to dry.
clue.vn-address-storefront-description: Vietnamese addresses appear on signs and follow a hierarchy from specific to general with key terms like phường, xã, quận, huyện, thị xã, thành phố, tỉnh.
clue.vn-province-name-abbreviation-descr: Province names and abbreviations (e.g. TG for Tien Giang) are useful parts of Vietnamese addresses.
clue.vn-area-code-description: Vietnamese area codes start with 2 followed by one or two digits, generally ordered north to south.
clue.vn-licence-plate-regional-code-desc: Vietnamese licence plate codes, often painted on trucks, help determine the region.
clue.vn-regional-place-name-prefix-descr: Some city name prefixes are regionally specific within Vietnam.
clue.vn-flat-agricultural-delta-descript: Wide open, flat agricultural fields are most common in the Red River Delta and less so in the Mekong Delta.
clue.vn-mekong-delta-canal-palm-tree-tit: Mekong Delta, Canals and Palm Trees
clue.vn-mekong-delta-canal-palm-tree-des: The Mekong Delta is flat and water-rich, criss-crossed by straight canals flanked by linear villages, with abundant palms.
clue.vn-central-highland-landscape-descr: The Central Highlands are hilly with distant mountains, red soil, and dry rolling farmland.
clue.vn-rubber-tree-plantation-descripti: Rubber plantations north of Ho Chi Minh City and in the Central Highlands have thin-trunked trees often wrapped in plastic and planted in dense grids.
clue.vn-tea-plantation-description: Vietnamese tea plantations are mainly in the north and Lam Dong province, with compact, trimmed plants in winding hillside rows.
clue.vn-khasi-pine-northeast-description: Clusters of Khasi pines on hills are typical of far northeastern Vietnam, especially Lang Son and Quang Ninh provinces.
clue.vn-dragonfruit-farm-description: Dragonfruit farms, resembling upturned wet mops, are found around Phan Thiet and the Long An / Tien Giang border.
clue.vn-dry-sandy-coast-northeast-phan-t: Dry Sandy Coast Northeast of Phan Thiet
The coast northeast of Phan Thiet is dry and sandy with some rocky sections.
clue.vn-black-pepper-plantation-descript: Black pepper vines in the Central Highlands shroud tree trunks with dense downward-pointing leaves.
clue.vn-wind-turbine-cluster-description: Wind turbines appear in several clusters mostly in southern Vietnam near Dalat, Buon Ma Thuot, Pleiku, Dong Hoi, Quy Nhon, Ho Chi Minh City, and Quang Tri.
clue.vn-roof-spire-north-description: Thin spires on house roofs are almost exclusively found in northern Vietnam.
clue.vn-red-river-delta-tall-boxy-house-: Red River Delta, Tall Boxy Houses
Houses around Hanoi and the Red River Delta are tall, multi-storey with gaudy Greco-Roman details.
clue.vn-mekong-delta-low-single-storey-h: Mekong Delta houses are boxy concrete and almost always single ground-level storey.
clue.vn-northwestern-stilt-house-descrip: Traditional wooden houses in northwestern Vietnam often have stilts, corrugated metal roofs, and triangular roof gable openings.
clue.vn-grave-agricultural-field-descrip: Single graves in the middle of agricultural fields are found in the Red River Delta.
clue.vn-stick-bamboo-fence-north-title: Stick and Bamboo Fences in the North
clue.vn-stick-bamboo-fence-north-descrip: Wooden fences of sticks or bamboo in a grid-like pattern appear in northern Vietnam.
clue.vn-black-pole-sticker-northern-desc: Poles in northern Vietnam often have black stickers with simple designs.
clue.vn-sand-dune-northern-khanh-hoa-tit: Sand Dunes in Northern Khanh Hoa
clue.vn-sand-dune-northern-khanh-hoa-des: A peninsula in far northern Khanh Hoa province has sand dunes hugging a mostly divided highway.
clue.vn-hoi-an-yellow-historic-buildings: Hoi An is identifiable by old yellow buildings with dark brown doors and details.
clue.vn-sa-pa-touristy-mountain-town-des: Sa Pa is a resort town deep in the northern mountains, overflowing with tourist shops, restaurants with excessive signage, and grand hotel buildings mixing European and Southeast Asian styles.
clue.vn-russian-cyrillic-signs-phan-thie: Russian Cyrillic Signs Near Phan Thiet
Near the beach resorts east of Phan Thiet, most signs include Cyrillic text alongside Vietnamese, catering to Russian tourists.
clue.vn-country-flag-description: The national flag of Vietnam is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.vi-distinctive-architecture-descrip: US Virgin Islands have a unique blend of European Renaissance, Spanish Baroque, Rococo, and Victorian styles with large arches and courtyards.
clue.vi-st-croix-grid-pattern-road-descr: St. Croix has primary roads in a loose grid angled WSW to ENE with cross streets NNW to SSE; other islands have curvier roads.
clue.vi-country-flag-description: The national flag of the US Virgin Islands is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.
clue.ad-stone-building-description: Stone buildings are common all across Andorra.
clue.rs-topography-north-description: Vojvodina in the north is flat, low-lying plains.
clue.rs-topography-south-description: Central and southern Serbia are hilly, with mountains in the southwest and southeast.
clue.ke-grey-pickup-description: In a lot of the Kenyan coverage, you can see the large grey Street View pickup truck, sometimes with a black snorkel.
clue.ch-14-romansch-speed-limit-descript: In Romansh-speaking Switzerland, the speed limit sign reads “limita generala” above the number
clue.ch-14-italian-description: In Italian-speaking Switzerland, the speed limit sign reads “Limite generale” above the number
clue.al-national-flag-desc: The Albanian flag is red with a black double-headed eagle in the center
clue.skane-flag-desc: Red field with a yellow Nordic cross offset toward the hoist. Commonly flown throughout Skåne on flagpoles, homes, and businesses.
clue.bw-road-signs-description-striped: Sign posts in Botswana are commonly seen striped in black and yellow.
clue.sun-to-south-description: The sun appears toward the south, which usually points to a northern-hemisphere location.
clue.sun-to-north-description: The sun appears toward the north, which usually points to a southern-hemisphere location.
clue.sun-overhead-description: The sun appears high overhead, which usually points to a location near the tropics.
clue.drives-on-left-description: Traffic here appears to drive on the left side of the road.
clue.drives-on-right-description: Traffic here appears to drive on the right side of the road.
clue.ge-language: Georgian uses its own unique script, Mkhedruli, with rounded letters and no uppercase. It is one of the world’s most distinctive languages.
clue.xx-general-01-35-stone-buildings-de: Stone buildings are common all across Andorra.
clue.ge-flags-description: Georgia's flag features one large red cross and four smaller red crosses on a white background.
clue.xk-license-plates-description: In Kosovo, license plates have a blue strip on the left side.
clue.lk-car-blur-description: In Sri Lanka, the Google car will often have blue-white-red patches.
clue.ca-flags-ns-desc: Nova Scotia's flag is white with a blue diagonal cross running corner to corner, and a gold shield bearing a red lion sits at the centre.
clue.ar-crossarm-pole-desc: Argentine concrete poles often carry short concrete crossarms up the upper part of the pole, sometimes alternating from one side to the other.
clue.se-sverigeleden-desc: Square cycle route signs with a white bicycle: green is the nationwide Sverigeleden network of 39 routes, while red marks one of only 16 named national routes and narrows the area far more.
clue.br-state-web-desc: Web addresses on Brazilian signage sometimes carry a state abbreviation as its own segment, as in www.example.ac.gov.br for Acre.
clue.mn-vehicles-right-desc: Mongolia drives on the right, yet over half of its cars are right-hand drive, largely due to used car imports from Japan.
clue.au-nsw-lp-desc: New South Wales plates are bright yellow, which stays obvious through the blur.
clue.au-vic-license-plates-description: Victorian plates are white with dark blue characters. A small blue downward-pointing triangle sits in the top middle, often showing up as just a dark dot through the blur.
clue.au-south-australia-licence-plate-de: South Australian plates are white with black characters, with no colour anywhere.
clue.au-western-australia-licence-plate-: Western Australian plates are white with blue characters under a solid blue banner carrying a small orange sun.
clue.au-tasmania-licence-plate-descripti: Tasmanian plates are white with blue characters and a gold emblem among the first characters. They are often visible as a white plate with a subtle dark blue divider in the center.
clue.au-northern-territory-licence-plate: Northern Territory plates are white with bright orange-red characters.
clue.au-australian-capital-territory-lic: Australian Capital Territory plates are white with blue characters, sometimes visible through the blur.
